A server-side request forgery flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform
automation-controller email notification backend. The email backend passes the user-supplied SMTP
host and port from a notification template directly to the SMTP client without validating that
the target is not an internal, loopback, link-local, or reserved address. An authenticated user
with organization notification-admin permission can create or modify an email notification
template pointing at an arbitrary internal address, trigger a test, and have the controller task
process open a raw TCP connection to that address. The resulting connection error is reflected
back through the notification record, providing a three-state internal port-scan oracle (open,
closed, filtered) over the control-plane's cluster network, including the in-cluster Kubernetes
API. When a shared organization template holds a stored SMTP password, redirecting the host can
also cause that credential to be transmitted to an attacker-controlled server.

An argument-injection flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation-controller
system-job subsystem. The system-job template launch endpoint stores a user-supplied "days"
variable without running the integer validation defined elsewhere for that field, and the
dispatcher flattens the management-command argument list into a single string with spaces before
the job runner re-splits it, so spaces in the value become additional command-line arguments.
Because system jobs are executed in-process on the control node without the container isolation
applied to all other job types, an authenticated user with superuser privileges can inject
arbitrary arguments — including Python's path option — into the control-plane awx-manage process,
controlling its argument vector and the first entry of its module search path. Full remote code
execution requires an additional import gadget that is not present in the current management
commands, so the demonstrated impact is argument injection with control of the process search
path rather than confirmed code execution.

A flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation-controller. The
WorkflowJobNode.ancestor_artifacts database column, which stores the raw merged set_stats
artifacts propagated between workflow nodes, is not wrapped in prevent_search() and is therefore
accepted for arbitrary field lookups by the REST filter backend, even though it is omitted from

authenticated user with no roles — can use the result count as a boolean/count oracle to recover,
character by character, secret values that a playbook author explicitly marked no_log, including

A flaw was found in the automation-controller instance
                  install-bundle endpoint. When a System Administrator downloads
                  an execution/hop node's install bundle, the controller signs an
                  X.509 certificate with the receptor mesh certificate authority
                  in which the Common Name, DNS subject-alternative-name, and
                  receptor node-id are taken verbatim from the caller-chosen
                  instance hostname, with a hard-coded ten-year validity, a random
                  serial, and no issuance log or revocation list. Because the
                  hostname charset validator is case-insensitive while the
                  uniqueness validator is case-sensitive, an administrator can
                  register a case variant of an existing control node's hostname
                  and obtain a mesh-CA-signed certificate that TLS peers, which
                  match hostnames case-insensitively, accept as that control node.
                  In managed/hosted deployments — where the customer holds
                  controller superuser but the platform operator runs the mesh —
                  this yields a long-lived, non-revocable mesh peer credential and,
                  with an on-path position, TLS impersonation or interception of
                  control/hybrid mesh nodes. It does not grant direct remote code
                  execution, because receptor work submission is gated by a
                  separate signing key not included in the bundle.

A flaw was found in the ipa_getkeytab module of the community.general
Ansible collection. The module's bind_pw parameter, used to supply the LDAP simple-bind password when retrieving a Kerberos keytab, is not declared with no_log, unlike the sibling password parameter in the same module. As a consequence, the supplied IPA/LDAP bind password is recorded in cleartext in the managed host's system journal/syslog (the module's "Invoked with" record), is included in the module's return values and verbose (-v) output, and is displayed in Automation Controller / AWX job output. The password is additionally passed on the command line to the ipa-getkeytab helper (as --bindpw <value>), exposing it in the process list to local users while the command runs. An attacker able to read these logs, job output, or the process table can obtain the directory bind credential, potentially compromising the accounts and objects that credential can access.

A flaw was found in Flatpak. A Time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition exists in the `org.freedesktop.Flatpak.SystemHelper` component. This vulnerability occurs because a privileged `chmod` operation executes before the OSTree repository validation within the `Deploy()` function. An attacker can exploit this timing window to redirect symlinks to arbitrary files, potentially leading to unauthorized file manipulation or information disclosure.

external logging (rsyslog) configuration is generated by interpolating
user-controlled settings — LOG_AGGREGATOR_HOST, LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH
and LOG_AGGREGATOR_RSYSLOGD_ERROR_LOG_FILE — into an rsyslog RainerScript config

A flaw was found in the automation-controller input-validation
                  guard sanitize_jinja(). The function uses two regular
                  expressions to reject user-supplied Jinja, but the patterns
                  stop at the first interior '}' or '%' character, so a Jinja
                  expression containing an inner brace (for example an empty
                  dict) is accepted while remaining valid Jinja. Because
                  sanitize_jinja() is the sole guard on several launch-time
                  fields — ad-hoc command module_args, Machine-credential
                  username / become_method / become_user, and inventory host
                  names — a low-privileged user can inject Jinja that ansible-core
                  evaluates in the execution environment. This enables execution
                  of arbitrary commands in the execution environment (bypassing an
                  administrator's AD_HOC_COMMANDS module allowlist) and disclosure
                  of secrets belonging to credentials the attacker cannot read
                  (by templating a co-attached credential's injected environment
                  variables), across the credential access-control boundary.

A flaw was found in Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform's automation-
controller. The setting that formats the log message emitted for API 4XX errors
is an administrator-controlled Python format-string template that is rendered
with a live user object as an argument. Because Python string formatting permits
attribute and item traversal on its arguments, an administrator can craft a
template that walks from the user object into the application settings and reads
the Django secret key and the database password. The formatted message is written
to a logger that can be forwarded to an external log aggregator, whose destination
is also administrator-controlled, allowing the secrets to be sent off the host. An
authenticated administrator can thereby obtain the master encryption key used to
protect all stored credentials and the database service password, enabling offline
decryption of every stored credential, forgery of user sessions, and direct
access to the controller database.

A flaw was found in Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform's automation-
controller. The HTML view of job, ad hoc command, project update, and inventory
update standard output escapes HTML metacharacters but does not remove ANSI
terminal escape sequences before conversion to HTML. An ANSI OSC 8 hyperlink
sequence in the output is expanded into an HTML anchor whose href is not scheme-

external party whose data a playbook echoes -- can embed a javascript: link that
is rendered into a text/html response with no Content-Security-Policy. When a
higher-privileged user views the output page and clicks the link, attacker-
controlled JavaScript executes in their authenticated session, allowing actions
as that user up to full platform takeover.

controller. Four debug views that trigger the internal task, dependency, and
workflow schedulers are configured to allow any user (including unauthenticated
clients) and are routed in production builds because their URL include is not

cves.d: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in BlueZ, the Linux Bluetooth protocol stack. A remote user within Bluetooth radio range can send a specially crafted Extended Inquiry Response (EIR) packet that causes a buffer overflow when the target device performs Bluetooth discovery. This vulnerability can lead to a Denial of Service (DoS) by crashing the bluetoothd service and may allow for arbitrary code execution.

CopyAPIView (awx/awx/api/generics.py:873) sets permission_classes =
(IsAuthenticated,), so DRF's get_object() performs no object-level
RBAC. The get() handler (lines 988–991) explicitly guards with
request.user.can_access(obj._class_, 'read', obj) — but post()
(lines 1001–1010) does not. POST only checks:

can_access(model, 'add', create_kwargs_check)

can_access(model, 'copy_related', obj)

For JobTemplate, can_add (awx/awx/main/access.py:1465–1520) gates on

inventory.use_role + project.use_role +
execution_environment.read_role — resource-level roles that do not
imply read on the source JT — and can_copy_related (1522–1534) checks
only credentials.use_role. None of these imply the caller can read the
source JT.

A reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in multiple WSO2 products due to insufficient output encoding in error messages generated by the JDBC user store connection validation request. A malicious actor can inject a specially crafted payload into the request, causing the browser to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the vulnerable page.

This vulnerability may allow UI manipulation, redirection to malicious websites, or data exfiltration from the browser. However, since all session-related sensitive cookies are protected with the httpOnly flag, session hijacking is not possible.

cves.d: Komodo through 2.3.3 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Periphery agent that allows unauthenticated attackers to connect as a trusted Core because empty core_public_keys and passkeys lists fail open by default. Attackers reaching port 8120 can present any generated keypair to issue Periphery API requests, including terminal sessions and container operations, executing commands on managed hosts typically as root.

BottleCRM 0.45 through 1.14.5 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in _read_upload() that reads entire CSV uploads before enforcing the 5 MB limit. Authenticated users with mass-import permission can send oversized CSV files concurrently to /api/contacts/import/ and /api/cases/import/ endpoints to exhaust worker memory and trigger out-of-memory termination.

BottleCRM 0.43 through 1.14.5 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated organization administrators to block web workers via unbounded routing rule regex patterns. Attackers can create a routing rule with a catastrophically backtracking pattern evaluated by _match_condition() during case saves, exhausting workers shared across all tenants.

BottleCRM through 1.14.5 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability in the send_email Celery task, which compiles the user-supplied AccountEmail message_body with django.template.Template(). Authenticated organization members can submit template tags through POST /api/accounts/<id>/create_mail/ to disclose the rendering context and loaded Python modules, or block the shared Celery worker with nested loops.

BottleCRM 0.30 through 1.14.5 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in render_invoice_template() that allows authenticated organization members to inject markup into custom-template invoice PDFs. Attackers can place HTML and CSS in notes, terms, client name or address fields to overlay totals, payee and payment instructions in PDFs served via download, public links and emails.

Dislocker through 0.7.3 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in get_vmk() and get_fvek() that allows attackers to trigger out-of-bounds heap reads via crafted datum sizes. Attackers can supply a malicious BitLocker volume image with a datum_size smaller than the 36-byte AES-CCM header, causing hexdump() to over-read and crash dislocker.

Erupt through 2.3.0 contains an HQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass tree-scoped data filters by injecting unescaped quotes into the linkTreeVal parameter of POST /erupt-api/data/table/{erupt}. Attackers holding query permission on entities with String-keyed linkTree targets can append always-true OR clauses or boolean subqueries to read data from other mapped entities.

Module: plugins/modules/keyring_info.py 

CVSS 3.1: 5.5 MEDIUM — AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N 

Issue: The module retrieves a passphrase from the OS native keyring (GNOME Keyring, macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager) and places it directly into result["passphrase"] with no output suppression, no no_log protection, and no documentation warning. 

Root Cause:

Line 105 (protected): keyring_password=dict(type="str", required=True, no_log=True)
Line 127 (NOT protected): result["passphrase"] = passphrase

Observed Output:

{
"changed": false,
"passphrase": "MyMasterP@ssw0rd!SSH_Key_Secret"
}
Visible via register + debug:
{
"keyring_result": {
"changed": false,
"passphrase": "MyMasterP@ssw0rd!SSH_Key_Secret"
}
}

Impact: 

Master passwords, SSH key passphrases and service credentials appear in all Ansible output 

register: keyring_result followed by debug: var=keyring_result prints passphrase in full 

Ansible fact caching backends (Redis, JSON file, memcached) may persist the passphrase 

AWX/Tower job logs silently store the live credential

Fix:

module.exit_json(changed=False, passphrase=passphrase, _ansible_no_log=True)

Also add a documentation warning requiring callers to use no_log: true at the task level.

cves.d: The Innovs HR WordPress plugin before 1.0.3.7.1 does not have CSRF checks in some places, which could allow attackers to make logged in users perform unwanted actions via CSRF attacks such as adding them as employees.

A flaw was found in SSSD. A local user can trigger a Denial of Service (DoS) by exploiting a race condition in the autofs responder between asynchronous enumeration completion and map invalidation. By repeatedly sending concurrent map enumeration and invalidation requests, an attacker can cause memory to leak, leading to excessive memory consumption that can disrupt or crash the autofs service.

A flaw was found in SSSD. An unprivileged local user can repeatedly request lookups for nonexistent entries through the Name Service Switch (NSS) responder. Because the negative cache does not limit the total number of stored entries and only removes expired records when an existing key is rechecked, the cache can grow without bound. This behavior can lead to memory exhaustion, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) as the responder becomes unresponsive or terminates.

A flaw was found in SSSD. A local user can cause a denial of service (DoS) by disrupting system authentication services. When handling Generic Security Services Application Programming Interface (GSSAPI) authentication in the Pluggable Authentication Module (PAM) responder, cached connection state is freed upon completion without clearing the reference pointer. An attacker can exploit this by sending an additional request over the same connection, causing the service to access invalid memory and unexpectedly terminate.

A flaw was found in sssd. A remote attacker can cause a denial of service (DoS) by submitting a certificate that lacks an expected Security Identifier (SID) extension. In deployments configured with SID-based certificate mapping rules, the service fails to verify the presence of the extension before processing it, causing the process to crash during authentication or lookup operations.

A flaw was found in SSSD. A local attacker can exploit this issue by sending a specially crafted request with an invalid packet length to the autofs responder UNIX socket. This causes an integer underflow and an out-of-bounds memory read, which can crash the responder process and result in a denial of service (DoS).

A flaw was found in SSSD's NFS idmap plugin. When retrieving cached user or group names, the plugin detects if an entry exceeds the destination buffer size but fails to abort before copying data. A local attacker can trigger this vulnerability by requesting identity lookups that resolve to oversized cached entries, resulting in an out-of-bounds write. This flaw primarily leads to a Denial of Service (DoS) by crashing the identity mapping service, and may also corrupt adjacent process memory.

A flaw was found in SSSD. An issue in the Kerberos Credential Manager (KCM) responder allows a local user to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by maintaining a persistent connection and repeatedly storing and destroying credentials. Because the service fails to release cached objects from memory when credentials are removed, memory consumption grows continuously, ultimately exhausting available memory and rendering the service unresponsive.

A flaw was found in SSSD. A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Kerberos Credential Manager (KCM) responder during Kerberos ticket-granting ticket (TGT) renewal, where a deferred callback accesses memory that has already been released. An authenticated local user with a renewable Kerberos ticket can trigger this issue on systems configured with KCM renewal, causing the KCM responder service to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

A flaw was found in SSSD. When configured to enforce account expiration using LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) shadow attributes, SSSD fails to treat an expiration value of zero as an expired account. A user with valid credentials for an expired account can exploit this flaw to bypass access controls and authenticate to the system. This allows unauthorized access to persist after the account was intended to be deactivated.

A flaw was found in SSSD. An unprivileged local user can repeatedly request master automount map updates through the autofs responder due to missing authorization checks. This triggers global cache invalidation and forces repeated lookups to backend directory providers, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) from degraded automount availability and elevated resource consumption.

A flaw was found in SSSD. In configurations where the autofs responder service is enabled, memory allocated during successful request processing is not released until the client connection terminates. A local attacker can exploit this vulnerability by maintaining an open connection and repeatedly submitting valid requests, leading to memory exhaustion and a Denial of Service (DoS).

NordVPN for Windows allows local attackers to stop unprotected Windows system services and change their startup type to Manual via named pipes. The NordVPN user-mode application allows a low-privileged attacker to act as a trusted process and connect to the named pipe "\\.\pipe\nord-security\v1\NordVpnService\Server". The attacker can then invoke the "ISettingsGrpc.StopService" and "ISettingsGrpc.ChangeServiceStartType" methods with an arbitrary service name, allowing them to stop any unprotected Windows service and change its startup type. This leads to denial of service of critical system services. Services protected by Windows (PPL processes, Windows Tamper Protection), such as Windows Defender, cannot be stopped or reconfigured.


This issue was fixed in version 8.12

Improper validation of the reset_url parameter of the Setup in-page search in Checkmk <2.5.0p15, <2.4.0p38, <2.3.0p51 and 2.2.0 (EOL) allows an attacker to execute arbitrary script in the session of an authenticated user with Setup access, or to redirect that user to an arbitrary external site, by tricking the user into opening a crafted URL and clicking the Reset button or submitting an empty search.

Apache ActiveMQ Artemis before 2.34.0 contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability in FederationStreamConnectMessage.getFederationPolicy(). The method calls Class.forName(clazz).getConstructor().newInstance() where clazz is read directly from the CORE protocol wire buffer without type validation. An authenticated federation peer can send a FEDERATION_DOWNSTREAM_CONNECT packet with a crafted class name, causing the broker to load and instantiate arbitrary classes visible to the Artemis module classloader. Static initializers (<clinit>) and no-argument constructors (<init>()) execute as side effects before the type cast, enabling denial of service via system-property poisoning, out-of-memory conditions via classloading, or broker state manipulation.

If an attacker manages to exhaust the heap space, this error is not detected and may lead to libssh using a partially initialized cipher context. cves.d: A flaw was found in evolution-data-server. Calendar events containing a file:// URI in their ATTACH property automatically read the targeted local file, base64-encode its contents and upload it back to the server when the event is saved. There are no file path restrictions or checks to verify whether the attachment originally came from the server or was added locally. This allows an attacker with access to a shared CalDAV calendar to exfiltrate arbitrary files the user has access to when interacting with malicious calendar events.

A DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Ansible Platform UI due to unvalidated input handling within the application's redirect route. Specifically, the application extracts a target destination from the next query parameter and directly assigns it to the browser's location.href without verifying its format or scheme. The platform includes built-in URL validation functions designed to block malicious URI schemes (such as javascript: and data:) as well as off-site or protocol-relative redirects, this specific route bypasses those controls. Consequently, an attacker can craft a malicious link that, when accessed by an authenticated user, causes arbitrary JavaScript to execute within the context of the user's session.

A flaw was found in ansible-runner. The unstream_dir() function, which receives and extracts a streamed zip archive on the worker side of the ansible-runner transmit/worker protocol, re-creates symbolic links from archive content without validating the link target and applies chmod() and utime() to an unsanitized filesystem path derived from the archive member name. A crafted archive processed by a worker that consumes attacker-influenced input can create files, create symbolic links, or change permissions outside the intended target directory, which can be leveraged toward code execution.

Path traversal / arbitrary file write in oc-mirror's operator catalog image extraction. When mirroring operator catalogs using either the legacy v1 path (--v1) or the OCI feature path (--use-oci-feature), oc-mirror extracts tar entries from catalog image layers without validating that file paths resolve within the intended destination directory.

The specific flaw exists within the rlottie library. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write before the start of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-30207.

A command injection vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated administrator to bypass system restrictions and run arbitrary commands as a root user. To be able to exploit this issue, the user must have access to the PAN-OS management interface.




The security risk posed by this issue is significantly minimized by restricting access to the management interface to only trusted internal IP addresses according to our recommended  best practice deployment guidelines https://live.paloaltonetworks.com/t5/community-blogs/tips-amp-tricks-how-to-secure-the-management-access-of-your-palo/ba-p/464431 .



This issue is applicable to PAN-OS software on PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls and on Panorama (virtual and M-Series).



Cloud NGFW and Prisma® Access are not affected by this vulnerability.

A local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect™ app enables a local user to escalate their privileges to root on macOS. This enables a non-administrative user to execute arbitrary commands with administrative privileges.

The GlobalProtect app on Linux, Windows, iOS, Android and Chrome OS is not affected by this vulnerability.

A command injection vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSOAR and Cortex XSIAM OS Query content pack enables an authenticated administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands on remote endpoints.

Sonatype Nexus Repository 3 allows a user that holds the role create or role update permission to grant roles and privileges that the account does not hold. This can give the user more access than intended, up to full administrative access.

The HDA audio device model did not check for zero-length Buffer Descriptor List (BDL) entries when starting a stream.  A zero-length entry caused an out-of-bounds read or write during DMA transfer processing.  BDL fields were also subject to modification by the guest after validation.

A malicious guest can crash the bhyve process or potentially execute arbitrary code in the host userspace context running the virtual machine, subject to bhyve's Capsicum sandbox.

The xHCI (USB 3) device model did not validate or save the event ring size provided by the guest.  The size was re-read from guest memory on each use, and Transfer Request Block (TRB) fields were loaded without protection against concurrent modification by the guest.  This race condition could be triggered by a guest running malicious, privileged code.

A malicious guest can crash the bhyve process or potentially execute arbitrary code in the host userspace context running the virtual machine, subject to bhyve's Capsicum sandbox.

Omada Controller's MSP and OpenAPI certificate/private-key management APIs do not properly enforce administrative authorization, allowing an authenticated user to perform privileged certificate management operations. 

Successful exploitation may allow a low-privileged authenticated user to upload or delete the controller's TLS certificate or private key, potentially disrupting secure management access.

The framebuffer device model's maximum resolution constants were duplicated between the framebuffer and RFB modules and had gotten out of sync.  Additionally, writes to the framebuffer BAR could set arbitrary width and height values without validation, and the framebuffer BAR I/O and RFB rendering threads were not synchronized.

A malicious guest can crash the bhyve process or potentially execute arbitrary code in the host userspace context running the virtual machine, subject to bhyve's Capsicum sandbox.

A vulnerability has been identified within Rancher where a user with the ability to create a project, on a certain cluster, can create a project with the same name as an existing project in a different cluster. This results in the user gaining access to the other project in the different cluster, resulting in a privilege escalation. This happens because the namespace used on the local cluster to store related resources (PRTBs and secrets) is the name of the project.

Wheels through 4.1.1 derives its default production error-email address from the Host header of the request that starts the application. If no explicit error-email recipient is configured, a mail server is configured, and the server accepts an attacker-chosen Host, an attacker whose request triggers a cold start can direct later error emails to an address under their control for that application's lifetime. Emails disclose error and request metadata; on engines/versions where scope dumps render, they may also disclose configuration secrets and other users' session/cookie data. On the Lucee 7 engine, scope dumps fail to render, limiting disclosure to header fields. This is fixed in 4.1.2.

Wheels 1.1 through 4.1.2 resolves nestedProperties() records by posted primary key without checking that they belong to the parent being saved. A user able to submit a nested form for their own parent can update and reassign another parent's hasMany or hasOne rows, or delete them when allowDelete=true. Nested belongsTo records can also be edited by posting another associated record's key. New child rows with composite primary keys not made up of foreign keys retain posted key values, allowing the request to choose their identity. This is fixed in 4.2.0.

Wheels 4.0.0 through 4.1.2 before 4.2.0 replaces incoming scope conditions with a primary-key condition in findByKey() and exists(key=). For exists(key=), production with error information disabled returns true for an out-of-scope key instead of throwing. Applications relying on scopes for ownership or tenant authorization can therefore load and subsequently modify or delete another user's or tenant's record when the key comes from a request. The 4.2.0 fix combines key conditions with incoming scope, query-builder or where conditions in findByKey(), exists(key=), updateByKey() and deleteByKey(). Other scope-aware finders, aggregates, updateAll() and deleteAll() are not affected.

cves.d: Backdrop CMS Core 1.35.x before 1.35.2 and 1.34.x before 1.34.6 does not sufficiently validate uploaded SVG images to ensure they lack potentially dangerous SVG tags. SVG images can contain clickable links or executable scripting. By uploading a crafted SVG, it is possible to execute scripting in the browser when an SVG image is viewed. This issue is mitigated by the attacker needing to be able to upload SVG images, and that Backdrop embeds all uploaded SVG images within tags, which prevents script from executing. The SVG must be viewed directly by its URL in order to run any embedded scripting.

In DragonFly BSD through 6.4.2 before 4bb22ff, the ARP input handlers arpintr() and in_arpinput() (sys/netinet/if_ether.c) do not validate the hardware address length (ar_hln) and protocol address length (ar_pln) fields of incoming ARP packets. in_arpreply() then uses these attacker-controlled values as memcpy lengths when copying from kernel buffers that are only 6 and 4 bytes long, resulting in an out-of-bounds read of kernel heap and stack memory that is copied into the ARP reply sent back to the requester. An unauthenticated attacker on the adjacent network can use a single crafted ARP request to disclose up to roughly 250 bytes of each type of kernel memory, including kernel pointers. This is expected to be fixed in the 6.6 stable release when that is available.

Frappe HRMS 14.x before 14.38.2, 15.x before 15.64.0, and 16.x before 16.18.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints caused by missing input validation. Any authenticated attacker, including a low-privilege account, can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to extract sensitive information from the database.

Nezha from 2.1.0 before 2.3.15 contains a host header injection vulnerability in mintTransferTool that builds fs.download_url and fs.upload_url transfer URLs from the unvalidated Host header. Attackers who control the Host header seen on a victim's MCP request can redirect file uploads or capture one-time download tokens and replay them to exfiltrate files.

Nezha 1.0.0 before 2.3.15 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the dashboard file manager WebSocket endpoint because fmStream never calls SetReadLimit, leaving message size unbounded. Authenticated users with file manager scopes can send one oversized binary message to /api/v1/ws/file/:id, triggering an OOM kill that drops all agent monitoring.

FreeRDP from 3.29.0 before 3.32.0 contains an integer overflow in the Apple audin backends (audin_mac.m, audin_ios.m), which compute the audio queue buffer size as FramesPerPacket * 2 * nChannels in UINT32 arithmetic, bypassing the CVE-2026-91962 fix. A malicious RDP server can send FramesPerPacket of 2^30 in the audin Open PDU to wrap the multiplication, causing undersized AudioQueueAllocateBuffer allocations and a heap out-of-bounds write in macOS and iOS clients.

FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows RAIL client that allows malicious RDP servers to trigger heap over-reads by sending non-NUL-terminated window titles. Attackers can send a full-length WINDOW_ORDER_FIELD_TITLE update that wf_rail_window_common passes to SetWindowTextW, corrupting titles or crashing the client.

A weakness has been identified in Ultralytics FastSAM up to b4ed20c2fed75eadc5aa7d8b09fedd137b873b52. This affects the function session.get_modelmeta.custom_metadata_map of the file ultralytics/nn/autobackend.py of the component AutoBackend Model Loading. This manipulation of the argument imgsz/names/kpt_shape causes improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code. The attack requires local access. This product uses a rolling release model to deliver continuous updates. As a result, specific version information for affected or updated releases is not available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

There is a defect in the CPython standard library module “mimetypes” where on Windows the default list of known file locations are writable meaning other users can create invalid files to cause MemoryError to be raised on Python runtime startup or have file extensions be interpreted as the incorrect file type.

This defect is caused by the default locations of Linux and macOS platforms (such as “/etc/mime.types”) also being used on Windows, where they are user-writable locations (“C:\etc\mime.types”).

To work-around this issue a user can call mimetypes.init() with an empty list (“[]”) on Windows platforms to avoid using the default list of known file locations.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability report highlights a severe concentration of critical flaws within Microsoft ecosystems, where heap-based buffer overflows and use-after-free errors in Windows kernel components, network services like DNS and DHCP, and productivity suites enable unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation across desktop, cloud, and infrastructure deployments. Parallel threats emerge in industrial control and IoT sectors, exposing Siemens equipment and smart devices to configuration manipulation, firmware tampering, and default credential abuse, while web and database platforms suffer from widespread deserialization attacks, cross-site scripting, and authentication bypasses that compromise data integrity and application logic. With indicators of active exploitation and a broad attack surface spanning endpoint workstations to hybrid cloud identity management, organizations face an urgent need to prioritize patches for memory corruption vulnerabilities and misconfiguration issues to prevent lateral movement and system compromise.
ai.summary_zh: 今日漏洞报告指出，Microsoft生态系统中存在大量高危漏洞集中现象。Windows内核组件、DNS与DHCP等网络服务及办公套件中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出与释放后使用漏洞，使得攻击者无需认证即可在桌面、云端及基础架构环境中实现远程代码执行与权限提升。与此同时，工业控制与物联网领域亦面临严峻威胁，Siemens设备及智能终端易受配置篡改、固件修改及默认凭据滥用攻击；Web与数据库平台则普遍遭受反序列化攻击、跨站脚本（XSS）及身份验证绕过，严重破坏数据完整性与应用逻辑。鉴于已发现活跃利用迹象且攻击面覆盖从终端工作站至混合云身份管理的广阔范围，企业亟需优先修补内存破坏类漏洞与配置缺陷，以防范横向移动与系统失陷。

items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者实现代码执行，进一步凸显了修补遗留 Office 组件的紧迫性。

items.reason_en: A critical use-after-free flaw in Windows Failover Cluster allows unauthenticated remote code execution, severely impacting high-availability infrastructure and cluster management services.
items.reason_zh: Windows Failover Cluster 中的关键释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重影响高可用基础设施及集群管理服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Volume Manager Extension Driver enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising core storage subsystems and disk management operations.
items.reason_zh: Volume Manager Extension Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接危及核心存储子系统与磁盘管理操作。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in the Windows Shell permits unauthenticated remote code execution, targeting fundamental user interaction layers and desktop environment processes.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的双重释放漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接针对基础用户交互层与桌面环境进程。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) allows unauthenticated remote code execution, affecting background task scheduling and update delivery mechanisms across endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，影响各端点的后台任务调度与更新交付机制。

items.reason_en: Improper path equivalence resolution in WebDAV enables remote code execution, frequently exploited in enterprise file-sharing and collaborative workspace environments.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的路径等价解析不当漏洞允许远程代码执行，在企业文件共享与协作工作区环境中常被利用。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables remote code execution. Its high CVSS and potential for exploitation via malicious media files make it a critical priority.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行。其高 CVSS 评分及可通过恶意媒体文件利用的特性，使其成为亟待修复的关键优先级。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in LSASS allows unauthorized network attackers to execute code. Compromising LSASS directly impacts credential theft and domain-wide security.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的越界写入漏洞允许未经授权的网络攻击者执行代码。LSASS 遭破坏将直接影响凭据窃取与全域安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Win32K GRFX permits local privilege escalation. As a core graphics subsystem, flaws here frequently lead to stable kernel exploits.
items.reason_zh: Win32K GRFX 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地权限提升。作为核心图形子系统，该处缺陷常导致稳定的内核漏洞利用。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Windows Shell allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges. Shell-level path manipulation can bypass security restrictions during file operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许已授权攻击者提升权限。Shell 级路径操纵可在文件操作过程中绕过安全限制。

items.reason_en: Critical integer underflow in DNS Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution, severely impacting network infrastructure and system stability.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的关键整数下溢漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重影响网络基础设施与系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Network Load Balancing enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a direct threat to Windows server deployments.
items.reason_zh: Network Load Balancing 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许免认证远程代码执行，对 Windows 服务器部署构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution via a heap overflow in the Windows Shell component poses significant risks for user interaction and file-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 组件中的堆溢出漏洞可导致未经身份验证的远程代码执行，对用户交互及基于文件的攻击构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the CCFFilter Driver allows unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising kernel-level system security and reliability.
items.reason_zh: CCFFilter Driver 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，危及内核级系统安全性与可靠性。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution through a heap overflow in Error Reporting can be triggered by processing malicious crash dumps, affecting system-wide telemetry services.
items.reason_zh: Error Reporting 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过处理恶意崩溃转储触发远程代码执行，影响系统级遥测服务。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in PowerShell permits remote code execution, endangering administrative automation and enterprise scripting workflows.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中的整数下溢漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及管理自动化与企业脚本工作流。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Windows Update allows privilege escalation during patch deployment, potentially bypassing security controls and enabling persistent compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update 中的命令注入漏洞允许在补丁部署期间提升权限，可能绕过安全控制并实现持久化入侵。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in the Key Distribution Center weakens Active Directory authentication mechanisms and Kerberos ticket validation.
items.reason_zh: Key Distribution Center 中的加密签名验证不当削弱了 Active Directory 身份验证机制与 Kerberos 票据验证。

items.reason_en: Critical network-accessible heap overflow in Libarchive enables remote code execution during file processing, posing a severe threat to system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Libarchive 中的关键网络可访问堆溢出漏洞允许在文件处理期间实现远程代码执行，对系统完整性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows iSCSI protocol stack allows unauthorized remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the iSCSI driver facilitates remote code execution, potentially compromising storage networks and host systems.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI 驱动程序中的越界写入漏洞可促成远程代码执行，可能危及存储网络与主机系统。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible heap overflow in the Rich Text Edit Control module allows remote attackers to achieve code execution without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Rich Text Edit Control 模块中的网络可访问堆溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: TCP/IP stack use-after-free vulnerability enables remote code execution, directly impacting core networking functionality and system stability.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接影响核心网络功能与系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: DNS Server use-after-free flaw allows remote attackers to execute code, threatening critical infrastructure and name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程攻击者执行代码，威胁关键基础设施与域名解析服务。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Libarchive permits remote code execution during archive extraction, widely used across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Libarchive中的双重释放漏洞允许在解压归档文件时执行远程代码，该组件广泛应用于企业环境中。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client use-after-free vulnerability exposes remote access sessions to potential exploitation by adjacent network attackers.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中的释放后使用漏洞使远程访问会话面临被相邻网络攻击者利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in LSASS directly targets Windows credential protection mechanisms, enabling highly sensitive local privilege escalation attacks.
items.reason_zh: LSASS中的释放后使用漏洞直接针对Windows凭据保护机制，可导致高敏感性的本地权限提升攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in AppX deployment extensions bypasses security boundaries, allowing authenticated users to escalate privileges locally.
items.reason_zh: AppX部署扩展中缺少授权检查可绕过安全边界，允许已认证用户进行本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Core Messaging enables local privilege escalation through privileged inter-process communication channels.
items.reason_zh: Core Messaging中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过特权进程间通信通道实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Kerberos integer underflow compromises authentication protocol integrity, facilitating local privilege escalation against domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos协议的整数下溢漏洞破坏了认证协议的完整性，便于对域控制器实施本地权限提升攻击。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Windows Update Service allows DLL sideloading techniques, leading to local privilege escalation during patching processes.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update Service中的不受信任搜索路径漏洞允许DLL侧加载技术，导致在补丁安装过程中发生本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET runtime enables network-based denial of service attacks against applications relying on managed frameworks.
items.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的低效算法复杂度漏洞可导致针对依赖托管框架的应用程序发起基于网络的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: SMB Server resource allocation flaw allows network-based denial of service, disrupting file sharing and inter-server communications.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server的资源分配缺陷可导致基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，破坏文件共享和服务器间通信。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library enables remote code execution via crafted media files, directly impacting end-user systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library中的整数溢出漏洞可通过精心构造的媒体文件实现远程代码执行，直接影响终端用户系统。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the Windows PDF parser allows remote code execution through malicious documents commonly delivered via phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows PDF解析器中的越界写入漏洞可通过钓鱼攻击中常见的恶意文档实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation error in Microsoft Office Word facilitates remote code execution, maintaining a high-risk attack surface for enterprise users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word中的数值截断错误漏洞可实现远程代码执行，为企业用户维持着高风险的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Cross-site request forgery against the OpenHuman desktop app's local Telegram auth callback allows attackers to hijack user sessions and gain unauthorized control over the desktop environment.
items.reason_zh: 针对OpenHuman桌面应用本地Telegram身份验证回调的跨站请求伪造漏洞，可使攻击者劫持用户会话并获取对桌面环境的未授权控制。

items.reason_en: TPM teardown ordering flaws in the Linux kernel risk race conditions during trusted key type unregistration, potentially leading to kernel instability or security bypass on systems relying on hardware-backed keys.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核中的TPM拆卸顺序缺陷可能在注销受信任密钥类型时引发竞态条件，导致依赖硬件支持密钥的系统出现内核不稳定或安全绕过风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8. Fixes an out-of-bounds read in the HID core when processing numbered reports, mitigating potential kernel panic or information disclosure from malicious USB/HID devices.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8。修复了HID核心在处理编号报告时的越界读取漏洞，缓解了恶意USB/HID设备可能导致内核崩溃或信息泄露的风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.4. Addresses a race condition where a threaded IRQ handler accesses an uninitialized mutex in the PCXHR audio driver, preventing kernel panics during audio device initialization.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.4。解决了PCXHR音频驱动中线程化IRQ处理程序访问未初始化互斥锁的竞态条件问题，防止音频设备初始化期间发生内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8. Resolves a use-after-free race in the Nouveau GPU driver's info ioctl by properly reserving buffer objects during VMA lookups, stabilizing desktop graphics performance.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.8。通过在VMA查找期间正确保留缓冲对象，解决了Nouveau GPU驱动info ioctl中的释放后使用竞态问题，稳定了桌面图形性能。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8. Corrects a bitfield clobbering bug in the VMware graphics driver where boolean assignments incorrectly overwrite allocation-size fields, preventing memory tracking corruption.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.8。修正了VMware图形驱动中的位字段覆盖错误，该错误会导致布尔赋值错误地覆盖分配大小字段，从而防止内存跟踪数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Oversized AMDGPU command buffers bypass validation limits, enabling local attackers to corrupt GPU memory and potentially escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 过大的AMDGPU命令缓冲区可绕过验证限制，使本地攻击者能够损坏GPU内存并可能实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unsigned finger index handling in the FocalTech touchscreen driver triggers an array out-of-bounds read, exploitable via malicious touch events.
items.reason_zh: FocalTech触摸屏驱动中无符号手指索引的处理逻辑会触发数组越界读取，可通过恶意触摸事件进行利用。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check in the ALSA FCP ioctl handler allows local users to trigger out-of-bounds writes, compromising audio subsystem integrity.
items.reason_zh: ALSA FCP ioctl处理程序中缺少边界检查，允许本地用户触发越界写入，破坏音频子系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Eliminates use-after-free in thermal hwmon sysfs error paths, blocking local privilege escalation via hardware monitoring interfaces.
items.reason_zh: 消除了thermal hwmon sysfs错误路径中的释放后使用漏洞，阻断了通过硬件监控接口进行的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Enforces correct mount idmap for fscrypt policy setting, ensuring encrypted filesystem access controls remain intact in containerized desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: 为fscrypt策略设置强制执行正确的挂载idmap，确保在容器化桌面环境中加密文件系统的访问控制保持完整。

items.reason_en: Fixes socket redirection use-after-free in BPF sockmap, protecting eBPF-powered network acceleration frameworks from local exploitation.
items.reason_zh: 修复了BPF sockmap中的套接字重定向释放后使用漏洞，保护eBPF驱动的網絡加速框架免受本地利用。

items.reason_en: Prevents delayed work use-after-free on Thunderbolt disconnect, securing USB4/Thunderbolt peripheral connections against malicious device injection.
items.reason_zh: 防止了雷雳断开连接时的延迟工作项释放后使用漏洞，保障了USB4/雷雳外设连接免受恶意设备注入威胁。

items.reason_en: Binds iSCSI TCP response data segments to connection buffers, preventing remote storage target exploitation via oversized SCSI sense data.
items.reason_zh: 将iSCSI TCP响应数据段绑定至连接缓冲区，防止通过过大的SCSI Sense数据对远程存储目标进行利用。

items.reason_en: Corrects out-of-bounds bitmap manipulation in ath12k Wi-Fi peer cleanup, mitigating driver crashes in modern Wi-Fi 6E/7 adapters.
items.reason_zh: 修正了ath12k Wi-Fi对等体清理过程中的越界位图操作，缓解了现代Wi-Fi 6E/7适配器中的驱动崩溃问题。

items.reason_en: Zeroes tile state data before GPU BIN jobs, preventing information disclosure between graphics rendering tasks on embedded and desktop displays.
items.reason_zh: 在GPU BIN作业前清零瓦片状态数据，防止嵌入式与桌面显示器的图形渲染任务之间发生信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Fixes power table use-after-free in AMDGPU sysfs interface, securing local users from exploiting concurrent power management writes.
items.reason_zh: 修复了AMDGPU sysfs接口中的电源表释放后使用漏洞，防止本地用户利用并发电源管理写入进行操作。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check on DMA command body size in VMware graphics driver allows local users to trigger out-of-bounds memory writes via privileged GPU operations.
items.reason_zh: VMware图形驱动中对DMA命令主体大小缺少边界检查，允许本地用户通过特权GPU操作触发越界内存写入。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Radeon display pitch alignment calculation can corrupt framebuffer memory, affecting graphical integrity and potentially enabling privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Radeon显示行距对齐计算中的整数溢出可能损坏帧缓冲区内存，影响图形完整性并可能导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Incorrect error handling for IOMMU scatterlist mapping in NVIDIA host1x driver leaves system vulnerable to DMA remapping failures during GPU initialization.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA host1x驱动中IOMMU分散列表映射的错误处理不当，导致系统在GPU初始化期间易受DMA重映射失败的影响。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in GIMP's DDS loader allows attackers to execute arbitrary code or crash the application by loading a specially crafted image file with manipulated dimensions. This poses a direct threat to desktop users handling untrusted graphics files.
items.reason_zh: GIMP的DDS加载器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过加载尺寸被篡改的特制图像文件来执行任意代码或导致应用程序崩溃。这对处理不受信任图形文件的桌面用户构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Crafted NTFS images trigger unbounded recursion causing stack overflow and local code execution.
items.reason_zh: 特制的NTFS镜像会触发无限递归，导致栈溢出和本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL bypass allows sandboxed processes to send signals outside their restricted domain.
items.reason_zh: LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL绕过漏洞允许沙箱进程向其受限域外发送信号。

items.reason_en: Vim netrw plugin breaks out of quoted contexts during mark/unmark operations, enabling arbitrary script execution.
items.reason_zh: Vim netrw插件在标记/取消标记操作期间会突破引用上下文限制，从而导致任意脚本执行。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in FreeRDP allows malicious servers to corrupt client memory, posing a direct remote code execution risk.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP中的堆越界写入漏洞允许恶意服务器破坏客户端内存，带来直接的远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated keyboard input injection in FreeRDP shadow server enables attackers to hijack remote desktop sessions before authentication completes.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP影子服务器存在未认证的键盘输入注入漏洞，使攻击者能够在认证完成前劫持远程桌面会话。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in FreeRDP's NLA mode parsing allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via crafted stream bytes.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP的NLA模式解析存在不受控的资源消耗问题，未认证的攻击者可利用特制的流字节耗尽服务器内存。

items.reason_en: Addresses potential use-after-free and NULL pointer dereferences during AMDGPU context initialization, improving graphics driver stability and preventing local privilege escalation via GPU exploits.
items.reason_zh: 解决了AMDGPU上下文初始化过程中潜在的释放后使用和空指针解引用问题，提升了显卡驱动稳定性，并通过防止GPU漏洞利用避免了本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Moves an out-of-bounds check for Intel HDCP stream arrays before the write operation, preventing memory corruption in display encryption workflows that could compromise system integrity.
items.reason_zh: 将针对Intel HDCP流数组的越界检查移至写操作之前，防止显示加密工作流中的内存损坏，从而保障系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Validates userspace-supplied array sizes for VMware SVGA shaders against available Shader Model limits, blocking potential GPU memory exploitation through malicious desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: 将VMware SVGA着色器的用户空间提供数组大小与可用的Shader Model限制进行校验，阻止通过恶意桌面应用程序对GPU内存的潜在漏洞利用。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in AMDGPU VCE command stream parsing allows malicious userspace to trigger buffer overflows, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution on desktop GPUs.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU VCE命令流解析中的整数溢出漏洞允许恶意用户空间触发缓冲区溢出，可能导致桌面GPU上的任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Phonet protocol stack can be exploited locally to corrupt kernel memory, posing a significant privilege escalation risk on Linux-based desktops and servers.
items.reason_zh: Phonet协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞可被本地利用以破坏内核内存，对基于Linux的桌面和服务器构成严重的权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Validates virtio-snd control metadata to prevent out-of-bounds indexing in virtualized audio subsystems commonly deployed in desktop VMs.
items.reason_zh: 对virtio-snd控制元数据进行校验，以防止常见于桌面虚拟机中的虚拟化音频子系统出现越界索引问题。

items.reason_en: Bounds F3A keymap allocation against GPIO counts in Synaptics touchpad drivers, fixing potential buffer overflows in laptop input stacks.
items.reason_zh: 在Synaptics触控板驱动中将F3A键位图分配限制在GPIO数量范围内，修复了笔记本输入栈中潜在的缓冲区溢出问题。

items.reason_en: Protects ptrace access checks with exec_update_lock in procfs, hardening process visibility boundaries against TOCTOU races.
items.reason_zh: 在procfs中使用exec_update_lock保护ptrace访问检查，加固进程可见性边界以防范TOCTOU竞争条件。

items.reason_en: Validates resolution counts in Hyper-V display driver to prevent array overruns in virtual desktop and remote session environments.
items.reason_zh: 对Hyper-V显示驱动中的分辨率计数进行校验，以防止虚拟桌面和远程会话环境中发生数组越界。

items.reason_en: Race condition in DRM GEM buffer object handle management can lead to use-after-free vulnerabilities, potentially allowing local privilege escalation in desktop GPU drivers.
items.reason_zh: DRM GEM缓冲对象句柄管理中的竞争条件可能导致释放后使用漏洞，进而可能在桌面GPU驱动中引发本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow during queue ID calculation in the AMDGPU KFD debugger can corrupt memory allocations or crash the display server when debugging compute workloads.
items.reason_zh: 在AMDGPU KFD调试器中进行队列ID计算时发生的整数溢出可能破坏内存分配或在调试计算负载时导致显示服务器崩溃。

items.reason_en: Malformed HID feature reports from Wacom tablets can trigger out-of-bounds writes due to incorrect field indexing, risking kernel memory corruption on input subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Wacom数位板发出的格式错误的HID功能报告可能因字段索引错误触发越界写入，危及输入子系统的内核内存安全。

items.reason_en: Lack of synchronization during ALSA sequencer teardown can cause race conditions that destabilize audio processing pipelines and may lead to local denial of service.
items.reason_zh: ALSA音序器销毁期间缺乏同步机制可能引发竞争条件，破坏音频处理流水线稳定性并可能导致本地拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Vulnerability in OpenText Endpoint Investigator agents allows unauthorized activity, directly compromising forensic and security tooling on Windows/Linux endpoints.
items.reason_zh: OpenText Endpoint Investigator代理中的漏洞允许未授权活动，直接破坏Windows/Linux终端上的取证与安全工具。

items.reason_en: Fixes user fence rejection in AMDGPU VCN rings to prevent command submission corruption and potential local privilege escalation on graphics workstations.
items.reason_zh: 修复AMDGPU VCN环中的用户栅栏（user fence）拒绝逻辑，防止命令提交损坏及图形工作站上的潜在本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in framebuffer font setting under memory pressure could leak kernel memory to local users on desktop systems.
items.reason_zh: 桌面系统在内存压力下设置帧缓冲区字体时若发生越界读取，可能导致内核内存向本地用户泄露。

items.reason_en: Fixes signed integer truncation in Intel GPU firmware IPC that could cause buffer overflows, directly impacting modern desktop graphics stability and security.
items.reason_zh: 修复Intel GPU固件IPC中的有符号整数截断问题，该问题可能引发缓冲区溢出，直接影响现代桌面图形的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Resolves a use-after-free condition during ALSA timer release, preventing kernel panics and memory corruption in desktop audio subsystems.
items.reason_zh: 解决了ALSA定时器释放期间的释放后使用问题，防止桌面音频子系统出现内核崩溃和内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Corrects MPTCP receive window shrinking constraints, fixing performance regressions and connection drops in desktop network managers utilizing multipath TCP.
items.reason_zh: 修正MPTCP接收窗口收缩的约束条件，修复使用多路径TCP的桌面网络管理器中出现的性能回退和连接中断问题。

items.reason_en: Fixes flag inheritance logic across io_uring bundle recv retries, addressing stability issues in modern Linux desktop application I/O pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 修复io_uring包接收重试过程中的标志继承逻辑，解决现代Linux桌面应用I/O流水线中的稳定性问题。

items.reason_en: Eliminates a timer migration livelock that can cause severe system latency or hangs on multi-core desktop workstations under heavy scheduling loads.
items.reason_zh: 消除了定时器迁移活锁问题，该问题在高调度负载下可能导致多核桌面工作站出现严重系统延迟或挂起。

items.reason_en: Prevents stale write-pointer mapping access in AMDGPU user queues, mitigating GPU command buffer corruption during concurrent context creation.
items.reason_zh: 防止在AMDGPU用户队列中访问陈旧的写指针映射，缓解并发上下文创建期间GPU命令缓冲区损坏的问题。

items.reason_en: Adds bounds validation to amdkfd SVM ioctls, blocking out-of-bounds buffer reads/writes exploitable by local user-space applications.
items.reason_zh: 为amdkfd SVM ioctls添加边界验证，阻止本地用户空间应用程序可利用的越界缓冲区读写操作。

items.reason_en: Fixes a peer runtime use-after-free in ALSA loopback during format changes, preventing desktop audio subsystem crashes and potential privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 修复ALSA回环(loopback)在格式变更期间的对等运行时释放后使用漏洞，防止桌面音频子系统崩溃及潜在的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unprivileged userspace can trigger an out-of-bounds write via the amdkfd ioctl, potentially leading to kernel privilege escalation on AMD GPUs commonly deployed in workstations and desktops.
items.reason_zh: 无特权用户空间可通过amdkfd ioctl触发越界写入，可能导致工作站和桌面机中常见部署的AMD GPU发生内核权限提升。

items.reason_en: The Bluetooth SMP implementation fails to enforce local security requirements before building pairing responses, creating a pathway for Man-in-the-Middle attacks on paired desktop peripherals.
items.reason_zh: Bluetooth SMP实现在构建配对响应前未强制执行本地安全要求，为已配对的桌面外围设备遭受中间人攻击提供了途径。

items.reason_en: The ALSA USB audio driver lacks sanity checks during playback silencing, allowing crafted URB packets to cause out-of-bounds memory writes that can crash or destabilize desktop audio subsystems.
items.reason_zh: ALSA USB音频驱动程序在静音播放期间缺乏合理性检查，允许构造的URB数据包引发越界内存写入，从而导致桌面音频子系统崩溃或不稳定。

items.reason_en: The drm/xe driver fails to track remap state correctly, causing kernel warnings and potential crashes during intensive 3D workloads.
items.reason_zh: drm/xe驱动程序未能正确跟踪重映射状态，在高强度3D负载期间会导致内核警告及潜在的系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: A race condition in sys_futex_requeue() allows flag mismatches that can trigger use-after-free scenarios in user-space synchronization.
items.reason_zh: sys_futex_requeue()中的竞争条件可导致标志位不匹配，进而触发用户空间同步机制中的释放后使用场景。

items.reason_en: Double free in the vfio/pci DMA-BUF error path destabilizes GPU passthrough functionality for virtualized desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: vfio/pci DMA-BUF错误路径中的双重释放漏洞会破坏虚拟化桌面环境中GPU直通功能的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Concurrent MEDIA_REQUEST_IOC_REINIT and VIDIOC_REQBUFS(0) calls race against queue teardown, risking video buffer corruption.
items.reason_zh: 并发调用MEDIA_REQUEST_IOC_REINIT与VIDIOC_REQBUFS(0)会与队列销毁过程产生竞争，存在视频缓冲区损坏风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in xe_oa_add_config_ioctl allows local attackers to exploit race conditions during GPU metric collection, potentially escalating privileges.
items.reason_zh: xe_oa_add_config_ioctl中的释放后使用漏洞允许本地攻击者在GPU指标收集期间利用竞争条件，从而可能实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Race condition in amdgpu job recovery exposes use-after-free during GPU resets, impacting desktop stability and local security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: amdgpu作业恢复过程中的竞争条件会在GPU重置时暴露释放后使用漏洞，影响桌面系统稳定性及本地安全边界。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in ALSA firewire-motu DSP event handling can corrupt user-space memory when unaligned buffers are passed to audio interfaces.
items.reason_zh: ALSA firewire-motu DSP事件处理中的缓冲区溢出漏洞在传递未对齐缓冲区至音频接口时可能损坏用户空间内存。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Alps input driver delayed work can be triggered by external PS/2 device reconnection, destabilizing laptop/desktop input subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Alps输入驱动程序延迟任务中的释放后使用漏洞可由外部PS/2设备重新连接触发，导致笔记本/桌面输入子系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: SLB multihit issue during preload on PowerPC systems causes incorrect memory translation, potentially leaking sensitive data or crashing applications.
items.reason_zh: PowerPC系统在预加载期间发生的SLB多重命中问题会导致错误的内存转换，可能泄露敏感数据或导致应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Lenovo Legion Zone allows local network attackers to execute arbitrary code, posing a direct threat to gaming and workstation environments.
items.reason_zh: Lenovo Legion Zone允许本地网络攻击者执行任意代码，对游戏和工作站环境构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Lenovo Baiying PC Client enables local authenticated users to escalate privileges and execute code with elevated rights.
items.reason_zh: Lenovo Baiying PC Client中的授权不当漏洞使本地已认证用户能够提升权限并以高权限执行代码。

items.reason_en: FreeRDP heap buffer overflow via integer wraparound in bitmap calculations allows local attackers to corrupt memory and potentially achieve code execution.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP位图计算中的整数回绕导致堆缓冲区溢出，允许本地攻击者破坏内存并可能实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: WebKitGTK's flawed drag-and-drop verification allows unauthorized local file disclosure, directly impacting Linux desktop environments and user privacy.
items.reason_zh: WebKitGTK缺陷的拖放验证机制允许未授权的本地文件泄露，直接影响Linux桌面环境及用户隐私。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free condition in the GRUB bootloader's gettext module can trigger system instability or compromise during early boot stages.
items.reason_zh: GRUB引导程序gettext模块中的释放后使用漏洞可能在早期启动阶段引发系统不稳定或安全性受损。

items.reason_en: FreeRDP's integer overflow in the Apple audio backend enables remote code execution when clients connect to malicious RDP servers.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP Apple音频后端中的整数溢出漏洞使客户端在连接恶意RDP服务器时可能遭受远程代码执行攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in SmsForwarder's HTTP server exposes sensitive device data like SMS, call logs, and contacts to unauthenticated network attackers.
items.reason_zh: SmsForwarder HTTP服务器缺失身份验证功能，会将短信、通话记录和联系人等敏感设备数据暴露给未认证的远程网络攻击者。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the ath6kl Wi-Fi driver aggregation reset function enables remote attackers to exploit memory corruption during connection state transitions on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: ath6kl Wi-Fi驱动程序聚合重置函数中的释放后使用漏洞使远程攻击者能够在移动设备连接状态切换期间利用内存破坏漏洞。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Bluetooth HCI sync UUID list traversal can cause kernel panics or information leaks when handling asynchronous device discovery requests on smartphones and tablets.
items.reason_zh: Bluetooth HCI同步UUID列表遍历过程中的竞争条件在处理智能手机和平板电脑的异步设备发现请求时可能导致内核恐慌或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Incorrect DBus policy on Ubuntu Touch allows arbitrary users to read files as root, severely compromising mobile device privacy and integrity.
items.reason_zh: Ubuntu Touch上错误的DBus策略允许任意用户以root身份读取文件，严重损害移动设备的隐私性与完整性。

items.reason_en: The Realtek WiFi driver fails to validate hardware TX release sequence numbers, which can trigger null pointer dereferences or system crashes on mobile and tablet Wi-Fi chips.
items.reason_zh: Realtek WiFi驱动程序未能验证硬件TX释放序列号，这可能在移动和平板Wi-Fi芯片上触发空指针解引用或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: The Broadcom WiFi driver uses raw firmware-provided interface indices without bounds checking, risking out-of-bounds array access on smartphones utilizing this chipset family.
items.reason_zh: Broadcom WiFi驱动程序在未进行边界检查的情况下直接使用固件提供的接口索引，可能导致使用该芯片组的智能手机发生越界数组访问。

items.reason_en: The Bluetooth L2CAP layer misinterprets connection response structures due to type confusion, potentially destabilizing mobile Bluetooth stacks during dynamic reconfiguration.
items.reason_zh: 由于类型混淆，Bluetooth L2CAP层错误解析了连接响应结构，可能在动态重配置期间破坏移动蓝牙协议栈的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Stack out-of-bounds read in l2cap_build_cmd() is triggered by malformed Bluetooth Enhanced Credit Based Connection Requests.
items.reason_zh: l2cap_build_cmd()中的栈区越界读取由格式错误的Bluetooth增强型基于信用连接请求触发。

items.reason_en: Unchecked dynamic array size in iwlwifi's match info handler leads to out-of-bounds reads during wireless frame processing.
items.reason_zh: iwlwifi匹配信息处理程序中未经验证的动态数组大小会导致无线帧处理期间发生越界读取。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in hci_le_big_create_sync occurs when connection parameters exceed allocated flex-array space.
items.reason_zh: 当连接参数超出分配的柔性数组空间时，hci_le_big_create_sync 中会发生栈缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Dangling pointer on mgmt_add_adv_patterns_monitor_complete triggers use-after-free when advertisement monitoring completes unexpectedly.
items.reason_zh: 当广告监控意外完成时，mgmt_add_adv_patterns_monitor_complete 中的悬垂指针会触发释放后使用（UAF）漏洞。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation in Telegram's rlottie library allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code upon user interaction with crafted media files.
items.reason_zh: Telegram的rlottie库中存在数值截断漏洞，允许远程攻击者在用户与构造的媒体文件交互时执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the UPnP Device Host driver allows local privilege escalation, posing significant risks to smart home and edge IoT devices relying on network discovery protocols.
items.reason_zh: UPnP设备主机驱动程序中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，对依赖网络发现协议的智能家居和边缘物联网设备构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the UPnP Device Host driver may lead to local privilege escalation on networked IoT appliances, potentially enabling persistent device compromise.
items.reason_zh: UPnP设备主机驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞可能导致联网IoT设备发生本地权限提升，进而可能实现设备的持久化失陷。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows Bluetooth Port Driver enables adjacent network privilege escalation, targeting wireless connectivity stacks commonly found in IoT gateways and peripherals.
items.reason_zh: Windows蓝牙端口驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞可实现相邻网络权限提升，主要影响常见于IoT网关和外设中的无线连接协议栈。

items.reason_en: EnergizeLab AI Station firmware ships with default root credentials and enabled SSH, granting immediate full device control to any attacker on the local network.
items.reason_zh: EnergizeLab AI Station固件附带默认的root凭据并启用了SSH，使得局域网上的任何攻击者均可立即获得设备的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal on the skill upload endpoint allows arbitrary file writes, enabling complete firmware or application tampering on deployed robots.
items.reason_zh: 技能上传端点存在未认证的路径遍历漏洞，允许任意文件写入，从而导致已部署机器人的固件或应用程序被完全篡改。

items.reason_en: The firmware updater uses a single hardcoded AES key across all installations, allowing attackers to decrypt and forge malicious firmware packages for any device.
items.reason_zh: 固件更新程序在所有安装实例中使用单一硬编码的AES密钥，使攻击者能够解密并为任何设备伪造恶意固件包。

items.reason_en: The NestJS auth service issues valid device tokens for arbitrary serial numbers without authentication, facilitating impersonation of any robot in the ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: NestJS认证服务在未进行身份验证的情况下为任意序列号签发有效的设备令牌，从而便于攻击者冒充生态系统中的任意机器人。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8. Validates individual Target Wake Time parameters before driver setup in mac80211, preventing crashes and denial-of-service from malformed Wi-Fi frames in IoT devices.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8。在mac80211驱动初始化前验证各个Target Wake Time参数，防止因IoT设备中的畸形Wi-Fi帧导致系统崩溃和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8. Eliminates dangling HCI connection references in Bluetooth ISO sockets, fixing use-after-free vulnerabilities that could destabilize audio streaming IoT endpoints.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8。消除蓝牙ISO套接字中的悬垂HCI连接引用，修复可能导致音频流媒体IoT终端不稳定的释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5. Initializes the receive buffer in the CAN J1939 transport layer, preventing information leaks of residual kernel memory in automotive and industrial IoT networks.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5。初始化CAN J1939传输层的接收缓冲区，防止汽车和工业IoT网络中出现残留内核内存的信息泄露。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.4. Fixes a race condition and improper error handling in the i.MX I2C slave registration, reducing crash risks in embedded systems relying on I2C peripheral communication.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.4。修复i.MX I2C从机注册过程中的竞态条件和错误处理不当问题，降低依赖I2C外设通信的嵌入式系统的崩溃风险。

items.reason_en: Unchecked SSID copying in the RIOT OS ATWINC15x0 WiFi driver causes a stack buffer overflow, enabling remote code execution on embedded IoT devices.
items.reason_zh: RIOT OS ATWINC15x0 WiFi驱动中未经验证的SSID复制会导致栈缓冲区溢出，从而在嵌入式IoT设备上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer truncation during Content-Length parsing in pupnp can lead to heap corruption or denial of service in UPnP-enabled IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: pupnp在解析Content-Length时发生的整数截断可能导致启用UPnP的IoT网关出现堆损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: FreeRTOS IPv6 Router Advertisement handler lacks source verification, allowing remote attackers to hijack device network configuration.
items.reason_zh: FreeRTOS IPv6路由器通告处理器缺乏源地址验证，允许远程攻击者劫持设备的网络配置。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation in FreeRTOS-Kernel MPU buffer authorization permits unprivileged tasks to read/write privileged kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: FreeRTOS-Kernel MPU缓冲区授权中的数值截断漏洞允许非特权任务读取/写入特权内核内存。

items.reason_en: FreeRTOS DNS resolver accepts forged replies, enabling remote cache poisoning and traffic interception.
items.reason_zh: FreeRTOS DNS解析器接受伪造的响应，从而导致远程DNS缓存投毒和流量拦截。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in FreeRTOS-Kernel's MPU port allows unprivileged tasks to read/write privileged kernel memory, breaking hardware-enforced isolation.
items.reason_zh: FreeRTOS-Kernel的MPU端口存在授权逻辑缺陷，允许非特权任务读写特权内核内存，破坏了硬件强制的安全隔离。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on Lantronix XPress-DR's UDP configuration protocol allows remote attackers to persistently overwrite device configurations.
items.reason_zh: Lantronix XPress-DR的UDP配置协议缺少身份验证机制，允许远程攻击者持久化覆盖设备配置。

items.reason_en: Missing minimum-length validation in RIOT OS's DHCPv6 client parser can lead to memory corruption when processing crafted option bodies.
items.reason_zh: RIOT OS的DHCPv6客户端解析器缺少最小长度验证，在处理构造的选项载荷时可能导致内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Prevents heap overflows in Broadcom WiFi drivers by validating firmware authentication frame lengths, protecting embedded IoT devices from malicious access point attacks.
items.reason_zh: 通过验证固件认证帧长度防止Broadcom WiFi驱动中出现堆溢出，保护嵌入式IoT设备免受恶意接入点攻击。

items.reason_en: Adds bounds checking for Atheros WiFi firmware beacon and association IE lengths, mitigating out-of-bounds reads triggered by crafted wireless frames targeting edge devices.
items.reason_zh: 为Atheros WiFi固件的信标和关联IE长度添加边界检查，缓解针对边缘设备的构造无线帧触发的越界读取问题。

items.reason_en: Binds device offsets in the WWAN modem MUX downlink decoder to prevent arbitrary memory traversal via malicious modem datagrams in cellular IoT gateways and industrial modems.
items.reason_zh: 将WWAN调制解调器MUX下行解码器中的设备偏移量进行绑定，防止通过蜂窝IoT网关和工业调制解调器中的恶意调制解调器数据报进行任意内存遍历。

items.reason_en: Flawed deferred processing of L2CAP channels in the Zephyr RTOS can lead to resource exhaustion or state corruption in Bluetooth-enabled IoT sensors and wearables.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS中L2CAP通道的延迟处理逻辑缺陷可能导致启用蓝牙的IoT传感器和可穿戴设备出现资源耗尽或状态损坏。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds reads in the rtl8723bs Wi-Fi driver IE parsing loop allow attackers to crash IoT devices or extract sensitive memory contents via malformed beacon frames.
items.reason_zh: rtl8723bs Wi-Fi驱动的IE解析循环中存在越界读取漏洞，攻击者可利用畸形信标帧导致IoT设备崩溃或提取敏感内存内容。

items.reason_en: Missing validation for frame lengths in mac802154 cryptographic decryption permits authentication bypasses, compromising the integrity of IEEE 802.15.4 based IoT networks like Zigbee and Thread.
items.reason_zh: mac802154加密解密过程缺少对帧长度的验证，可导致认证绕过，破坏基于IEEE 802.15.4的IoT网络（如Zigbee和Thread）的完整性。

items.reason_en: Fixes out-of-bounds bit access in HID multitouch driver, mitigating memory corruption triggered by malicious touchscreen reports in embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: 修复HID多点触控驱动中的越界位访问问题，缓解由嵌入式设备中的恶意触摸屏报告触发的内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Rejects invalid I2C block transfer lengths in stub drivers, preventing buffer overruns in embedded sensor communication buses.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝桩驱动中无效的I2C块传输长度，防止嵌入式传感器通信总线中出现缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Initializes algorithm key lengths for IPComp states, ensuring proper cryptographic parameter handling in IoT VPN and tunnel endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 初始化IPComp状态的算法密钥长度，确保在IoT VPN和隧道端点中正确处理加密参数。

items.reason_en: Fixes firmware load work teardown in CS35L41 audio codecs, preventing use-after-free scenarios when IoT devices dynamically unload drivers.
items.reason_zh: 修复CS35L41音频编解码器中固件加载工作项的清理过程，防止IoT设备动态卸载驱动时发生释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Failure to clear channel identifiers during L2CAP extended credit reconfiguration can cause state confusion, enabling Bluetooth IoT device hijacking or denial of service.
items.reason_zh: 在L2CAP扩展信用重配置期间未能清除通道标识符可能导致状态混淆，从而允许劫持蓝牙IoT设备或实施拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of duplicate destination CIDs in L2CAP connection responses triggers kernel crashes when processing incoming Bluetooth Low Energy traffic.
items.reason_zh: L2CAP连接响应中未正确处理重复的目标CID，会在处理传入的蓝牙低功耗流量时触发内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Malicious Thunderbolt peers can exploit integer wrapping in property validation to bypass safety checks and trigger out-of-bounds memory access on connected peripherals.
items.reason_zh: 恶意的Thunderbolt对等设备可利用属性验证中的整数回绕漏洞绕过安全检查，并在已连接的外设上触发越界内存访问。

items.reason_en: Enforcing strict IPv6-only acceptance on 6LoWPAN interfaces prevents protocol confusion attacks where non-IP frames could be incorrectly routed or processed in constrained IoT networks.
items.reason_zh: 在6LoWPAN接口上强制实施严格的仅IPv6接收策略，可防止协议混淆攻击，避免非IP数据帧在受限IoT网络中被错误路由或处理。

items.reason_en: In-place crypto transformation bug in 802.15.4 security layer could cause buffer corruption and compromise IoT device integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: 802.15.4安全层中的原地加密转换缺陷可能导致缓冲区损坏，进而破坏IoT设备的完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in RFCOMM listener cleanup allows remote attackers to crash Bluetooth stacks or execute code via crafted frames on IoT gadgets.
items.reason_zh: RFCOMM监听器清理过程中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程攻击者通过构造的数据帧使IoT设备的蓝牙栈崩溃或执行代码。

items.reason_en: Validates skb length before casting protocol structs, preventing out-of-bounds reads from malicious remote Bluetooth devices in IoT networks.
items.reason_zh: 在强转协议结构体前验证skb长度，防止IoT网络中恶意远程蓝牙设备发起的越界读取。

items.reason_en: Rejects oversized Broadcast Announcement prepend payloads in Bluetooth HCI, mitigating denial-of-service and memory corruption in Bluetooth-enabled IoT gadgets.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝Bluetooth HCI中过大的广播公告前置负载，缓解蓝牙IoT设备面临的拒绝服务及内存损坏风险。

items.reason_en: Validates and rejects oversized EMA RNR lists in Wi-Fi nl80211, preventing heap corruption in wireless chipsets widely deployed in smart home and industrial IoT.
items.reason_zh: 在Wi-Fi nl80211中验证并拒绝过大的EMA RNR列表，防止广泛部署于智能家居和工业IoT中的无线芯片组发生堆损坏。

items.reason_en: Fixes a bulk-out buffer overflow in the KL5KUSB105 USB-to-serial driver, closing a critical attack vector for embedded IoT communication modules.
items.reason_zh: 修复KL5KUSB105 USB转串口驱动中的批量输出缓冲区溢出漏洞，封堵嵌入式IoT通信模块的关键攻击面。

items.reason_en: Synchronizes RX data at the correct hardware packet offset in Marvell MVPP2 drivers, preventing DMA-related memory corruption in IoT network switches.
items.reason_zh: 在Marvell MVPP2驱动中将RX数据同步至正确的硬件数据包偏移量，防止IoT网络交换机发生DMA相关内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Drops unsupported Protocol Field Compression frames in PPPoE, hardening broadband router implementations against malformed packet injection attacks.
items.reason_zh: 丢弃PPPoE中不支持的协议字段压缩帧，增强宽带路由器实现抵御畸形包注入攻击的能力。

items.reason_en: Resolves use-after-free and race conditions in the Bluetooth HCI UART driver, hardening embedded Bluetooth controller implementations against remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: 解决蓝牙HCI UART驱动中的释放后使用漏洞与竞态条件，增强嵌入式蓝牙控制器实现抵御远程利用的能力。

items.reason_en: Removes a dangerous static variable in mac80211 fast-RX paths, preventing concurrent wireless frame processing crashes common in IoT routers and gateways.
items.reason_zh: 移除mac80211快速RX路径中的危险静态变量，防止IoT路由器和网关中常见的并发无线帧处理崩溃。

items.reason_en: Fixes an out-of-bounds read and infinite loop in Bluetooth LE BIG complete events, protecting Bluetooth audio peripherals and wearables from denial-of-service.
items.reason_zh: 修复蓝牙LE BIG完成事件中的越界读取与无限循环漏洞，保护蓝牙音频外设和可穿戴设备免受拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: The Wacom Bluetooth HID driver processes reports without sufficient bounds checking, allowing maliciously crafted short reports to trigger out-of-bounds reads on IoT touch controllers.
items.reason_zh: Wacom蓝牙HID驱动程序在未进行充分边界检查的情况下处理报告，使得恶意构造的短报告可在IoT触控控制器上触发越界读取。

items.reason_en: The HID core subsystem removes a bogus memset that previously cleared incoming data strings, effectively mitigating potential out-of-bounds data leakage in various embedded input devices.
items.reason_zh: HID核心子系统移除了先前用于清除传入数据字符串的无效memset调用，有效缓解了各类嵌入式输入设备中潜在的越界数据泄露问题。

items.reason_en: The multitouch HID driver does not verify that feature request responses match the original request ID, causing state confusion and potential memory corruption in multi-touch sensor implementations.
items.reason_zh: 多点触控HID驱动程序未验证功能请求响应是否与原始请求ID匹配，导致多点触控传感器实现中出现状态混淆及潜在的内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded credentials in EseeCloud IoT devices allow attackers to bypass authentication and gain full administrative control.
items.reason_zh: EseeCloud IoT设备中的硬编码凭据允许攻击者绕过身份验证并获取完全的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in i2c_hid_get_report via user-controlled report length can compromise embedded touch/display controllers in IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: 通过用户可控的报告长度在i2c_hid_get_report中引发的缓冲区溢出，可能危及IoT网关中嵌入式触控/显示控制器的安全。

items.reason_en: Uncanceled MLO scan work in iwlwifi leads to init-after-free, destabilizing WiFi 6E connectivity modules in modern IoT and edge devices.
items.reason_zh: iwlwifi中未取消的MLO扫描工作项会导致释放后初始化漏洞，破坏现代IoT和边缘设备中WiFi 6E连接模块的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check on interface ID in DPAA2-Switch IRQ handler allows hardware status manipulation to crash switch firmware in network appliances.
items.reason_zh: DPAA2-Switch中断处理程序中缺少对接口ID的边界检查，允许通过操纵硬件状态导致网络设备中的交换机固件崩溃。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds I2C message handling in DVB-USB dtv5100 via user-controlled length affects set-top boxes and media streaming hardware.
items.reason_zh: 通过用户可控长度在DVB-USB dtv5100中引发的越界I2C消息处理问题，会影响机顶盒和媒体流播放硬件的安全。

items.reason_en: Lack of serialization in MTD rawnand lock/unlock operations can corrupt concurrent flash writes in industrial IoT storage controllers.
items.reason_zh: MTD rawnand锁定/解锁操作缺乏序列化机制，可能导致工业IoT存储控制器中并发闪存写入发生损坏。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded cryptographic keys in ZKTeco BioTime compromise communication confidentiality and integrity, enabling remote interception or spoofing of biometric access control systems.
items.reason_zh: ZKTeco BioTime中的硬编码加密密钥破坏了通信的机密性与完整性，使攻击者能够远程拦截或伪造生物识别门禁系统。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the BlueZ Bluetooth stack enables remote exploitation within radio range during device discovery scans.
items.reason_zh: BlueZ蓝牙协议栈中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许攻击者在设备发现扫描期间于无线电范围内进行远程利用。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center中不恰当的证书验证机制可导致通过网络进行未授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Microsoft Bookings allows attackers to elevate privileges using user-controlled cryptographic keys.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Bookings中的授权绕过漏洞允许攻击者利用用户可控的加密密钥提升权限。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse permits direct remote code execution on affected cloud instances.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dataverse 中不可信数据的反序列化可导致受影响的云实例直接远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure App Service allows unauthenticated actors to execute arbitrary code within tenant environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 缺失身份验证功能，允许未认证的攻击者在租户环境中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Hyper-V enables local privilege escalation that directly impacts cloud virtualization workloads.
