items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中的路径遍历缺陷可使已认证用户获取更高权限，暴露敏感的ERP配置。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core enables remote denial-of-service attacks against web applications and APIs.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中无限制的资源分配可导致针对Web应用与API的远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: PgBouncer enters an infinite loop when processing malformed StartupMessage options, causing a denial of service for all connected clients due to blocked connection processing.
items.reason_zh: PgBouncer在处理格式错误的StartupMessage选项时会进入无限循环，因连接处理阻塞导致所有已连接客户端遭受拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: DragonflyDB allows unbounded memory allocation via negative COUNT parameters in set/list commands, enabling unauthenticated clients to trigger out-of-memory crashes.
items.reason_zh: DragonflyDB允许在set/list命令中使用负数COUNT参数进行无限制的内存分配，使未认证客户端能够触发内存耗尽崩溃。

items.reason_en: Excessive maxNameLength constraints in FasterXML Jackson JSON parsing can lead to uncontrolled memory consumption and denial of service when processing deeply nested or oversized property names.
items.reason_zh: FasterXML Jackson JSON解析中过大的maxNameLength限制在处理深层嵌套或过长的属性名时，可能导致不受控的内存消耗及拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Storing journal info pointers during inode caching creates a use-after-free window, threatening stability and security of Ceph metadata servers.
items.reason_zh: 在inode缓存期间存储日志信息指针会形成释放后使用（UAF）漏洞窗口，威胁Ceph元数据服务器的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Delayed FREE_STATEID operations in NFS expose a use-after-free condition, allowing local attackers to corrupt network file system state and crash clients.
items.reason_zh: NFS中延迟的FREE_STATEID操作会暴露释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，允许本地攻击者破坏网络文件系统状态并导致客户端崩溃。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in Amazon Neptune's Gremlin graph import component allows authenticated database users to execute arbitrary code and exfiltrate internal credentials. This directly compromises managed database integrity and cloud tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Amazon Neptune的Gremlin图导入组件中存在不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞，允许经过身份验证的数据库用户执行任意代码并窃取内部凭据。这直接破坏了托管数据库的完整性和云租户隔离性。

items.reason_en: Neo4j GraphQL silently ignores schema-level @authentication directives on @cypher fields, completely bypassing intended access controls.
items.reason_zh: Neo4j GraphQL在@cypher字段上静默忽略模式级别的@authentication指令，完全绕过了预期的访问控制。

items.reason_en: IBM Planning Analytics contains a stack-based buffer overflow exploitable by remote authenticated attackers for arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: IBM Planning Analytics存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，远程经过身份验证的攻击者可利用该漏洞执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Eclipse Vert.x HTTP header canonicalization incorrectly interprets malformed headers, facilitating request smuggling or routing bypasses.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Vert.x的HTTP头规范化机制错误解析畸形头，可能导致请求走私或路由绕过。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in MariaDB's ST_AsText function during deeply nested GeometryCollection conversion can lead to memory corruption and potential code execution.
items.reason_zh: MariaDB的ST_AsText函数在处理深度嵌套的GeometryCollection转换时存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致内存损坏及潜在的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stale references left by SYS_REFCURSOR reallocation in MariaDB allow low-privileged attackers to access unauthorized routine contexts.
items.reason_zh: MariaDB中SYS_REFCURSOR重新分配遗留的失效引用，允许低权限攻击者访问未授权的例程上下文。

items.reason_en: The #mysql50# bypass prefix in MariaDB circumvents normal table-name filesystem encoding, potentially leading to unauthorized file system access.
items.reason_zh: MariaDB中的#mysql50#绕过前缀可规避正常的表名文件系统编码，可能导致未经授权的文件系统访问。

items.reason_en: Insufficient isolation between shared servers in IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty could allow cross-server data leakage or privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty中共享服务器之间的隔离不足，可能导致跨服务器数据泄露或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Acceptance of invalid bucket types in Ceph's CRUSH decoder breaks data distribution logic, potentially causing massive data loss or availability issues in distributed database backends.
items.reason_zh: Ceph的CRUSH解码器接受无效的桶类型会破坏数据分布逻辑，可能导致分布式数据库后端出现大规模数据丢失或可用性故障。

items.reason_en: Failure to reject monitor maps advertising zero monitors in libceph prevents proper cluster initialization validation, leaving middleware clusters vulnerable to split-brain scenarios and misrouting.
items.reason_zh: libceph未能拒绝通告零个监视器的监视器映射，导致无法正确进行集群初始化验证，使中间件集群易受脑裂场景和路由错误的影响。

items.reason_en: Maximum severity flaw in 9P client walk error path allows local privilege escalation by manipulating file identifiers in shared filesystems.
items.reason_zh: 9P客户端walk错误路径中存在最高严重性缺陷，通过操纵共享文件系统中的文件标识符可实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free in pNFS layout update allows remote attackers to crash servers or execute code via crafted NFS requests.
items.reason_zh: pNFS布局更新中存在严重的释放后使用漏洞，远程攻击者可利用构造的NFS请求导致服务器崩溃或执行代码。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Nessus allows authenticated users to read or modify scan data, compromising vulnerability management database integrity.
items.reason_zh: Nessus中存在SQL注入漏洞，允许经过身份验证的用户读取或修改扫描数据，破坏漏洞管理数据库的完整性。

items.reason_en: The SCSI qla2xxx Fibre Channel driver suffers a double-free condition during error handling, risking kernel panic and catastrophic data loss in enterprise storage arrays and SANs.
items.reason_zh: SCSI qla2xxx光纤通道驱动程序在错误处理期间存在双重释放问题，可能导致企业存储阵列和SAN发生内核恐慌及灾难性数据丢失。

items.reason_en: Libceph authentication reply handler performs out-of-bounds access on malformed messages, threatening distributed storage cluster integrity and database backend availability.
items.reason_zh: Libceph的身份验证响应处理器对畸形消息执行越界访问，威胁分布式存储集群的完整性及数据库后端的可用性。

items.reason_en: Libceph message header processing allows out-of-bounds reads if frame lengths are corrupted, enabling information disclosure in Ceph-based database storage layers.
items.reason_zh: 若帧长度损坏，Libceph的消息头处理过程允许越界读取，从而导致基于Ceph的数据库存储层发生信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Ext4 filesystem allocator fails to handle integer wraparound when searching indirect blocks, potentially corrupting metadata and compromising large-scale database storage volumes.
items.reason_zh: Ext4文件系统分配器在搜索间接块时未能正确处理整数回绕，可能损坏元数据并危及大规模数据库存储卷。

items.reason_en: Dropping AIL lock during XFS push callbacks risks log item corruption, threatening transactional consistency in database-backed storage engines.
items.reason_zh: 在XFS推送回调期间释放AIL锁可能导致日志项损坏，威胁基于数据库的存储引擎的事务一致性。

items.reason_en: Dereferencing freed log items after XFS push callbacks can cause kernel panics during heavy database write workloads and checkpointing.
items.reason_zh: 在XFS推送回调之后解引用已释放的日志项，可能在重数据库写入负载和检查点操作期间引发内核恐慌。

items.reason_en: IO_uring task work flag race during ring resize can corrupt asynchronous I/O state, impacting middleware performance and reliability.
items.reason_zh: 环形缓冲区调整大小期间IO_uring任务工作标志的竞争条件可能损坏异步I/O状态，影响中间件的性能与可靠性。

items.reason_en: Race condition in RPMSG core driver override string handling leads to use-after-free in inter-processor communication used by edge middleware.
items.reason_zh: RPMSG核心驱动程序中覆盖字符串处理的竞争条件会导致边缘中间件使用的进程间通信发生释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Socket leak on handshake cancellation exhausts file descriptors, causing denial of service for database connection pools and middleware services.
items.reason_zh: 握手取消时的套接字泄漏会耗尽文件描述符，导致数据库连接池和中间件服务拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in PgBouncer allows attackers knowing a valid user password to impersonate any other SCRAM-authenticated user, including superusers.
items.reason_zh: PgBouncer的身份验证机制不当，允许掌握有效用户密码的攻击者冒充任何其他SCRAM认证用户，包括超级用户。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Wheels Python package affects MySQL/MariaDB drivers when backslash escaping is disabled, compromising applications using inline-literal paths.
items.reason_zh: Wheels Python包中存在SQL注入漏洞，当禁用反斜杠转义时会影响MySQL/MariaDB驱动程序，危及使用内联字面量路径的应用程序。

items.reason_en: Python format string vulnerability in Ansible Automation Platform's API error logging enables information disclosure or service disruption.
items.reason_zh: Ansible Automation Platform的API错误日志记录中存在Python格式化字符串漏洞，可导致信息泄露或服务中断。

items.reason_en: Unfiltered deserialization in JBoss Marshalling's Infinispan session replication path allows cluster-wide remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: JBoss Marshalling的Infinispan会话复制路径中存在未过滤的反序列化漏洞，可导致整个集群范围的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unsafe reflection via ActiveMQ Artemis's CORE protocol wire buffer enables arbitrary class instantiation and subsequent remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 通过ActiveMQ Artemis的CORE协议网络缓冲区进行不安全的反射，可实现任意类实例化并随后执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Red Hat EAP's JDKBridge accepts attacker-supplied CDR codebase URLs, permitting unauthenticated class loading before security interceptors execute.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat EAP的JDKBridge接受攻击者提供的CDR代码库URL，允许在安全拦截器执行之前进行未认证的类加载。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager enables network privilege escalation, compromising enterprise device management and deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager中的SQL注入漏洞可实现网络权限提升，破坏企业设备管理与部署流水线。

items.reason_en: Improper path resolution in the Windows Backup Engine allows local privilege escalation, undermining system recovery capabilities and backup integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Backup Engine中的路径解析不当允许本地权限提升，削弱系统恢复能力与备份完整性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in GIMP's PVR plug-in triggers a heap-based buffer overflow when processing crafted images, affecting desktop creative applications.
items.reason_zh: GIMP的PVR插件中存在整数溢出漏洞，在处理恶意构造的图像时会触发基于堆的缓冲区溢出，影响桌面创意类应用程序。

items.reason_en: Hypervisor-level use-after-free in Hyper-V risks host isolation breaches, potentially allowing guest-to-host escape scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V中存在的Hypervisor级释放后使用漏洞可能破坏主机隔离机制，存在导致客户机逃逸至主机的风险。

items.reason_en: Double free in the Failover Cluster Virtual Driver enables remote code execution, directly impacting high-availability cluster stability.
items.reason_zh: 故障转移群集虚拟驱动程序中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接影响高可用集群的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Kernel-mode use-after-free represents a critical local privilege escalation path, demanding immediate patching to protect OS integrity.
items.reason_zh: 内核态释放后使用漏洞构成一条关键的本地提权路径，需立即打补丁以保护操作系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows kernel provides a reliable exploitation vector for local privilege escalation attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows内核中的堆溢出漏洞为本地提权攻击提供了可靠的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in OneNote demonstrates recurring memory corruption patterns in productivity tools, necessitating targeted mitigation strategies.
items.reason_zh: OneNote中的释放后使用漏洞揭示了办公效率工具中反复出现的内存损坏模式，亟需制定针对性的缓解策略。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Python allows local privilege escalation, impacting development environments, automation scripts, and cross-platform runtime workflows.
items.reason_zh: Python中不恰当的权限管理机制可导致本地提权，影响开发环境、自动化脚本及跨平台运行时工作流的安全。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation. Hypervisor vulnerabilities can potentially break isolation between guest VMs and host systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V中存在越界读取漏洞，可导致本地提权。Hypervisor层漏洞可能破坏客户机虚拟机与宿主机之间的隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in OpenSSH for Windows allows local privilege escalation. OpenSSH is a standard remote administration tool, making its hardening essential.
items.reason_zh: Windows版OpenSSH中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地提权。作为标准远程管理工具，对其加强安全加固至关重要。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Kerberos permits local privilege escalation. Kerberos handles ticket granting, and flaws here can facilitate authentication bypasses.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos协议中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致本地提权。Kerberos负责票据发放，该处缺陷可能被用于绕过身份认证。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Storage allows local privilege escalation. Storage drivers operate at ring 0, requiring rigorous bounds checking.
items.reason_zh: Windows存储子系统存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地提权。存储驱动运行于Ring 0级别，必须实施严格的边界检查。

items.reason_en: OAuth session creation bypass in Mage OSS due to unknown provider handling could lead to unauthorized access in identity federation and web authentication scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Mage OSS因未正确处理未知身份提供商，导致OAuth会话创建可被绕过，可能在身份联合与Web认证场景中引发未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT secret keys in MCP Context Forge allow trivial authentication bypass and immediate administrative account takeover.
items.reason_zh: MCP Context Forge中硬编码的JWT密钥极易被利用以实现身份认证绕过，并直接导致管理员账户被接管。

items.reason_en: Command permission gate bypass in Mistral Vibe lets attackers execute arbitrary shell commands by obfuscating substitutions within LLM prompts.
items.reason_zh: Mistral Vibe存在命令权限门控绕过漏洞，攻击者可通过在大语言模型（LLM）提示词中混淆替换逻辑，执行任意Shell命令。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the widely used jq CLI tool during string operations can trigger memory corruption in automated data processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 广泛使用的jq命令行工具在进行字符串操作时存在整数溢出漏洞，可能触发自动化数据处理流水线中的内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Sandbox blacklist bypass in Heym allows authenticated users to execute unrestricted Python code within agentic workflow environments.
items.reason_zh: Heym的沙箱黑名单机制存在绕过漏洞，允许已认证用户在智能体工作流环境中执行无限制的Python代码。

items.reason_en: Eclipse NetX Secure TLS client copies peer-supplied cookie data without bounds checking during HelloRetryRequest handling, risking buffer overflows and potential remote code execution in embedded TLS stacks.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse NetX Secure TLS客户端在处理HelloRetryRequest消息时，未进行边界检查即复制对端提供的Cookie数据，可能导致缓冲区溢出，进而危及嵌入式TLS栈的安全并存在远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Linux Ceph client's __kick_flushing_caps() occurs during concurrent cap message handling and lock drops, threatening storage cluster stability and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Linux Ceph客户端__kick_flushing_caps()函数中存在释放后使用漏洞，该问题发生于并发处理能力消息及释放锁的过程中，威胁存储集群的稳定性与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Linux NFSd async copy cancel/shutdown paths allows racing kthreads to access freed memory, posing significant stability and exploitation risks for network file servers.
items.reason_zh: Linux NFSd服务的异步复制取消或关闭路径中存在释放后使用漏洞，竞态条件下的内核线程可能访问已释放内存，对网络文件服务器的稳定性与安全构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Stale pointer retention in the Linux SMB client's free_tgts() leaves a dangling reference to freed cache structures, which can be exploited to cause kernel panics or arbitrary memory writes.
items.reason_zh: Linux SMB客户端free_tgts()函数中存在陈旧指针保留问题，会遗留指向已释放缓存结构的悬空引用，可被利用导致内核崩溃或实现任意内存写入。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8. Disables preemption in BPF stack tracing to resolve recursion slot release timing issues, improving eBPF program stability and debugging reliability.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分7.8。通过禁用BPF堆栈跟踪中的抢占机制，解决递归槽释放的时序问题，从而提升eBPF程序的稳定性与调试可靠性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.2. Fixes uninitialized local ID restoration during MPTCP SYN cookie reconstruction, preventing connection state corruption in Multipath TCP deployments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分8.2。修复了MPTCP SYN Cookie重建过程中未初始化本地ID的恢复问题，防止多路径TCP部署中出现连接状态损坏。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8. Hardens RPCSEC_GSS opaque length validation in gss_unwrap_resp_priv, blocking buffer overflow exploits targeting Kerberos-wrapped RPC traffic.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分9.8。强化了gss_unwrap_resp_priv中对RPCSEC_GSS不透明长度的验证机制，阻断针对Kerberos封装RPC流量的缓冲区溢出攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8. Rejects Kerberos v2 wrap tokens with oversized encryption cipher fields, mitigating memory corruption risks in SUNRPC authentication layers.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分9.8。拒绝包含超大加密密文字段的Kerberos v2封装令牌，降低SUNRPC认证层的内存损坏风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.3. Forces Access Control Service (ACS) requests when Intel TXT tboot is enabled, ensuring strict IOMMU isolation for secure boot and trusted execution environments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分9.3。在启用Intel TXT tboot时强制发起访问控制服务（ACS）请求，确保安全启动与可信执行环境获得严格的IOMMU隔离。

items.reason_en: Releasing a disk without stopping its timeout timer leads to kernel panics during hardware probe failures, impacting system reliability across diverse deployments.
items.reason_zh: 在未停止超时定时器的情况下释放磁盘，会在硬件探测失败时引发内核崩溃，影响各类部署环境下的系统可靠性。

items.reason_en: Improper cleanup of detached perf event groups triggers a use-after-free, compromising performance monitoring tools used for system profiling and debugging.
items.reason_zh: 分离的perf事件组清理不当会触发释放后使用漏洞，损害用于系统性能分析与调试的监控工具。

items.reason_en: Secures vsock/virtio worker locks during device suspend/resume, improving stability for guest-host communication in appliances and edge devices.
items.reason_zh: 在设备挂起与恢复期间锁定vsock/virtio工作线程锁，提升了专用设备及边缘设备中客户机-主机通信的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Prevents unbounded recursion in SLAB allocator free path, avoiding kernel panics under heavy memory pressure across diverse server and workstation loads.
items.reason_zh: 防止SLAB分配器释放路径中出现无限递归，避免在高内存压力下引发内核崩溃，保障各类服务器与工作站的稳定运行。

items.reason_en: Resolves deadlock between metadata writeback and transaction commit in Btrfs zoned mode, enhancing reliability for enterprise storage arrays and NAS.
items.reason_zh: 解决了Btrfs分区模式下元数据回写与事务提交之间的死锁问题，提升了企业存储阵列与NAS系统的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Fixes audit rule deletion race condition, ensuring compliance logging remains consistent during dynamic security policy modifications.
items.reason_zh: 修复审计规则删除的竞争条件，确保在动态修改安全策略期间合规日志保持一致。

items.reason_en: Clamps USB audio frame sizes in implicit-feedback mode, preventing buffer overflows triggered by malicious or misbehaving USB sound peripherals.
items.reason_zh: 限制隐式反馈模式下的USB音频帧大小，防止由恶意或行为异常的USB音频外设触发的缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Prevents use-after-free on Open vSwitch meter attachment failure, maintaining control-plane stability in software-defined networking deployments.
items.reason_zh: 修复Open vSwitch计量器附加失败时的释放后使用漏洞，维护软件定义网络部署中的控制平面稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical DMA cleanup flaw in Cavium crypto driver uses incorrect loop indices, causing buffer leaks and repeated unmapping that destabilizes cryptographic hardware acceleration.
items.reason_zh: Cavium加密驱动程序中存在关键的DMA清理缺陷，使用了错误的循环索引，导致缓冲区泄漏和重复取消映射，从而破坏硬件加密加速的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Lack of synchronization during RxRPC socket teardown exposes raw pointers to preallocation routines, creating race conditions exploitable for kernel memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: RxRPC套接字拆除期间缺乏同步机制，导致原始指针暴露给预分配例程，产生可被利用进行内核内存破坏的竞争条件。

items.reason_en: Flexible array member indexing in NVMe multipath structures using NUMA node IDs exceeds allocated bounds, risking out-of-bounds reads/writes during storage I/O.
items.reason_zh: NVMe多路径结构中使用NUMA节点ID对灵活数组成员进行索引时超出已分配边界，在存储I/O期间存在越界读写风险。

items.reason_en: Absence of length bounds in NTFS volume cluster number parsing allows crafted update logs to trigger out-of-bounds memory reads, compromising filesystem integrity.
items.reason_zh: NTFS卷簇号解析缺乏长度边界检查，允许构造的更新日志触发越界内存读取，损害文件系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Regression in BPF filesystem inode cleanup causes use-after-free during map unpinning, threatening kernel stability when eBPF programs are dynamically managed.
items.reason_zh: BPF文件系统inode清理过程中的回归缺陷在解除固定时引发释放后使用漏洞，当动态管理eBPF程序时会威胁内核稳定性。

items.reason_en: SELinux previously omitted connect-related permission checks for TCP Fast Open, allowing processes to bypass mandatory access control policies during connection establishment. Applying this fix restores strict network policy enforcement.
items.reason_zh: SELinux此前未对TCP Fast Open执行连接相关的权限检查，导致进程在建立连接时可绕过强制访问控制策略。应用此修复可恢复严格的网络策略执行。

items.reason_en: A premature cache destruction in the TIPC bearer cleanup path triggers a use-after-free condition during concurrent network operations, risking kernel panic or privilege escalation. This stabilizes the Linux network stack under load.
items.reason_zh: TIPC承载体清理路径中过早销毁缓存会在并发网络操作期间触发释放后使用条件，可能导致内核恐慌或权限提升。此修复增强了Linux网络栈在高负载下的稳定性。

items.reason_en: nvmet-auth trusts allocation lengths without proper bounds checking, risking authentication bypass in NVMe over Fabrics deployments.
items.reason_zh: nvmet-auth在未进行适当边界检查的情况下盲目信任分配长度，可能导致NVMe over Fabrics部署中的身份验证绕过风险。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel frag-transfer helpers fail to propagate shared-fragment markers, causing network stack state corruption and potential crashes.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核分片传输辅助函数未能正确传播共享分片标记，导致网络栈状态损坏及潜在崩溃。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in doc-recog allows attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands by embedding substitution syntax in crafted document paths.
items.reason_zh: doc-recog中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，攻击者可通过在构造的文档路径中嵌入替换语法来执行任意Shell命令。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Linux kernel's dm-verity FEC calculation can be triggered to corrupt memory, impacting disk integrity verification.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核dm-verity的前向纠错（FEC）计算中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可被触发以破坏内存，影响磁盘完整性验证。

items.reason_en: Unbounded PERSISTENT RESERVE OUT parameter parsing in Linux kernel SCSI target allows attackers to read beyond received buffers.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核SCSI目标设备中无界的PERSISTENT RESERVE OUT参数解析允许攻击者读取接收缓冲区之外的数据。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Linux kernel's iSCSI target REGISTER AND MOVE operation can lead to memory corruption and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核iSCSI目标设备的REGISTER AND MOVE操作中存在释放后使用漏洞，可能导致内存破坏和权限提升。

items.reason_en: Fixes a use-after-free in BPF socket storage during early clone bailouts, securing eBPF-based observability and networking tools against memory corruption during process forking.
items.reason_zh: 修复早期克隆回退过程中BPF套接字存储区的释放后使用漏洞，保护基于eBPF的可观测性与网络工具在进程fork期间免受内存破坏。

items.reason_en: Corrects the auth_hmacs array size definition in SCTP cookies, preventing potential buffer mismatches and cryptographic bypasses during secure association parameter processing.
items.reason_zh: 修正SCTP Cookie中auth_hmacs数组大小的定义，防止在处理安全关联参数时出现潜在的缓冲区不匹配及密码学绕过问题。

items.reason_en: Blocks RDS messages from crossing network namespace boundaries, enforcing strict isolation for remote direct memory access protocols in multi-tenant and isolated computing environments.
items.reason_zh: 阻止RDS消息跨越网络命名空间边界，在多租户和隔离计算环境中强制执行远程直接内存访问协议的严格隔离。

items.reason_en: Timing issue in KVM nVMX shadow VMCS clearing after VMCLEAR allows nested virtualization workloads to access freed memory, risking host escape or guest instability.
items.reason_zh: KVM nVMX在VMCLEAR后清除影子VMCS时存在时序问题，允许嵌套虚拟化工作负载访问已释放内存，可能导致主机逃逸或客户机不稳定。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in BPF sockmap push data fallback path enables memory corruption when handling large network payloads, affecting eBPF-based traffic management and observability tools.
items.reason_zh: BPF sockmap推送数据回退路径中的整数溢出漏洞在处理大型网络载荷时可导致内存破坏，影响基于eBPF的流量管理与可观测性工具。

items.reason_en: Missing validation of ACE subauth counts in ksmbd NTACL copying allows buffer overflows in SMB server responses, compromising file sharing services across heterogeneous environments.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd复制NTACL时缺少对ACE子授权计数的验证，导致SMB服务器响应中出现缓冲区溢出，危及异构环境中的文件共享服务。

items.reason_en: Corrects carry overflow flaws in ECC vli multiplication, addressing mathematical weaknesses that could degrade elliptic curve cryptography implementations.
items.reason_zh: 修正ECC vli乘法中的进位溢出缺陷，解决可能削弱椭圆曲线密码学实现的数学弱点。

items.reason_en: Ensures full object zeroing in the slab allocator even with red zoning enabled, preventing sensitive data leakage from uninitialized kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: 即使启用红区功能，也确保slab分配器完全清零对象，防止未初始化内核内存中的敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Fixes data races on audit queue length readers, maintaining the integrity of system call auditing and forensic logging capabilities.
items.reason_zh: 修复审计队列长度读取器的数据竞争问题，维持系统调用审计与取证日志功能的完整性。

items.reason_en: Corrects incorrect sizeof usage in iommufd event queue reading, preventing out-of-bounds reads in virtualization and hardware isolation frameworks.
items.reason_zh: 修正iommufd事件队列读取中sizeof的错误用法，防止在虚拟化与硬件隔离框架中发生越界读取。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during VMCI handshake termination can be exploited by compromised guest VMs to escalate privileges on the host hypervisor or crash shared memory services.
items.reason_zh: VMCI握手终止期间的释放后使用漏洞可能被受损的客户机虚拟机利用，以提升宿主机Hypervisor的权限或导致共享内存服务崩溃。

items.reason_en: Attacker-controlled header lengths can cause unsigned arithmetic underflows in IPsec state management, resulting in out-of-bounds writes that compromise kernel memory safety.
items.reason_zh: 攻击者可控制的头部长度会导致IPsec状态管理中发生无符号算术下溢，进而引发越界写入，破坏内核内存安全性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in 32-bit packet number comparison breaks MACsec replay protection, allowing authenticated attackers to inject or reorder secure network frames undetected.
items.reason_zh: 32位数据包编号比较中的整数溢出会破坏MACsec重放保护，使经过身份验证的攻击者能够隐蔽地注入或重排序安全网络帧。

items.reason_en: Fixes race conditions during ebtables module cleanup that could lead to use-after-free vulnerabilities when dynamically adding or removing bridge firewall rules at runtime.
items.reason_zh: 修复ebtables模块清理期间的竞争条件，防止在运行时动态添加或删除网桥防火墙规则时引发释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free in exfat directory entry lookup enables local privilege escalation or kernel panic on Linux storage systems.
items.reason_zh: exfat目录项查找中的严重释放后使用漏洞可导致Linux存储系统发生本地权限提升或内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Driver probe failure handling prevents resource leaks and potential crashes when clock notifier registration fails in serial port subsystems.
items.reason_zh: 串口子系统时钟通知器注册失败时的驱动探测失败处理机制可防止资源泄漏及潜在崩溃。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in keyctl parameter handling could allow local privilege escalation via crafted system calls targeting kernel credential managers.
items.reason_zh: keyctl参数处理中的缓冲区溢出漏洞可能允许攻击者通过针对内核凭证管理器的构造系统调用实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Reloads inner IPv6 headers after GSO offloads, fixing stale pointer dereferences that could crash the kernel or leak sensitive memory.
items.reason_zh: 在GSO卸载后重新加载内部IPv6头部，修复了可能导致内核崩溃或敏感内存泄露的过期指针解引用问题。

items.reason_en: Eliminates use-after-free during ICMPv6 reception by removing temporary address variables, hardening the core network stack against race exploits.
items.reason_zh: 通过移除临时地址变量消除ICMPv6接收过程中的释放后使用漏洞，增强了核心网络栈对竞态条件利用的防御能力。

items.reason_en: Resolves a double-free condition in TIPC buffer append logic, preventing memory corruption in Trill/IS-IS routing protocol implementations.
items.reason_zh: 修复TIPC缓冲区追加逻辑中的双重释放问题，防止Trill/IS-IS路由协议实现发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Fixes use-after-free on inexact bin pruning in XFRM policy management, strengthening IPsec policy enforcement against concurrent access attacks.
items.reason_zh: 修复XFRM策略管理中非精确分箱修剪过程的释放后使用漏洞，强化IPsec策略执行机制以抵御并发访问攻击。

items.reason_en: Corrects AMD IOMMU clone_alias to reference the original device ID, preventing incorrect DMA mapping aliasing that compromises system memory isolation.
items.reason_zh: 修正AMD IOMMU中clone_alias指向原始设备ID的问题，防止因错误的DMA映射别名化导致系统内存隔离失效。

items.reason_en: Validates server-supplied DACLOFFSET before constructing ACL pointers, preventing critical out-of-bounds writes when mounting misconfigured SMB shares.
items.reason_zh: 在构建ACL指针前验证服务器提供的DACLOFFSET值，防止挂载配置错误的SMB共享时发生关键越界写入。

items.reason_en: Stops partial re-decryption of rxrpc RESPONSE packets, eliminating state corruption and potential data leakage in distributed RPC clients.
items.reason_zh: 阻止rxrpc RESPONSE数据包的局部重解密，消除分布式RPC客户端中的状态损坏与潜在数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Addresses insecure remote script execution in Red Hat ACM operator builds, mitigating supply chain risks where unverified code gains access to CI/CD credentials.
items.reason_zh: 修复Red Hat ACM operator构建中存在的不安全远程脚本执行问题，缓解未经验证代码窃取CI/CD凭据带来的供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Adds page map validation to block layer biovec merging, preventing unsafe DMA coalescing that could trigger kernel panics or memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: 在块层biovec合并过程中增加页映射验证，防止引发内核崩溃或内存损坏的不安全DMA合并操作。

items.reason_en: Consolidated kthread exit paths fix prevents use-after-free on corrupted RCU callbacks, addressing a fundamental kernel stability issue impacting diverse server and edge deployments.
items.reason_zh: 统一kthread退出路径的修复机制可防止损坏的RCU回调引发的释放后使用漏洞，解决了影响各类服务器与边缘部署的核心内核稳定性问题。

items.reason_en: The crypto af_alg subsystem experiences page reassignment overflow during scatter-gather list pulls, risking memory corruption in user-space cryptographic APIs and middleware.
items.reason_zh: crypto af_alg子系统在处理分散-聚集列表时发生页重新分配溢出，可能导致用户态密码学API及中间件内存损坏。

items.reason_en: The SCSI target file backend fails to initialize aio command structures, allowing bogus I/O control block values that could destabilize storage emulation and virtualization middleware.
items.reason_zh: SCSI target文件后端未能正确初始化aio命令结构，导致非法I/O控制块值传入，可能破坏存储仿真与虚拟化中间件的稳定性。

items.reason_en: JPEGParser enters an infinite loop when parsing crafted or truncated streams, causing denial of service in imaging applications.
items.reason_zh: JPEGParser在解析构造或截断的数据流时会陷入无限循环，导致图像应用发生拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Inadequate MP4 box size validation leads to parsing loops and resource exhaustion when processing malformed multimedia files.
items.reason_zh: MP4 box大小验证不足在处理畸形多媒体文件时将导致解析死循环与资源耗尽。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated HL7 ADT messages can reassign patient records across identities, severely compromising healthcare data integrity.
items.reason_zh: 未经认证的HL7 ADT消息可跨身份篡改患者记录归属，严重破坏医疗数据的完整性。

items.reason_en: Undefined behavior in the BPF interpreter's signed division and modulo handlers can cause unpredictable eBPF program execution.
items.reason_zh: BPF解释器中有符号除法与取模处理程序的未定义行为可能导致eBPF程序执行结果不可控。

items.reason_en: Wrong descriptor completion cursor in DMA engine IDXD can corrupt memory transfers across hardware accelerators, affecting general compute workloads.
items.reason_zh: DMA引擎IDXD中错误的描述符完成游标可能导致跨硬件加速器的内存传输损坏，进而影响通用计算任务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free between futex_key_to_node_opt and vma_replace_policy poses a local privilege escalation risk in multi-threaded applications.
items.reason_zh: futex_key_to_node_opt与vma_replace_policy函数间的释放后使用漏洞可能在多线程应用中引发本地权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Inline fallback reservation leak in Btrfs causes progressive ENOSPC errors, degrading overall system storage availability and application performance.
items.reason_zh: Btrfs文件系统内联回退预留泄漏会导致渐进式ENOSPC错误，降低系统整体存储可用性与应用性能。

items.reason_en: Stuck SCSI commands after chip reset in qla2xxx prevent proper resource cleanup, leading to persistent I/O hangs across the entire system.
items.reason_zh: qla2xxx驱动芯片复位后SCSI命令卡滞会阻碍正常资源回收，导致全系统范围持续I/O挂起。

items.reason_en: Deferred hook memory release UAF in netfilter BPF allows concurrent dump operations to corrupt kernel slab memory, impacting firewall reliability.
items.reason_zh: netfilter BPF中延迟钩子内存释放引发的释放后使用漏洞，允许并发转储操作损坏内核slab内存，影响防火墙可靠性。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel Landlock subsystem fix addresses incorrect handling of disconnected directories from bind mounts, preventing potential filesystem isolation bypasses.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核Landlock子系统修复了绑定挂载中孤立目录处理不当的问题，防止潜在的虚拟文件系统隔离绕过。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free condition in Red Hat GCC libstdc++ binary heap priority queue can be triggered to corrupt memory and lead to application crashes or exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat GCC libstdc++二进制堆优先队列中的释放后使用漏洞可被触发以破坏内存，导致应用崩溃或被恶意利用。

items.reason_en: Code injection in SGLang evaluation sandbox allows remote attackers to escape Python restrictions via regex globals, executing arbitrary code in AI inference workloads.
items.reason_zh: SGLang评估沙箱中的代码注入漏洞允许远程攻击者通过正则表达式全局变量突破Python限制，在AI推理任务中执行任意代码。
